title: Middle East Sales Controller (Finance Controller)
description:
About SKF 

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company sustainable and competitive business excellence.

 

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms. About the organization: www.skf.com/in

 

SKF Purpose Statement

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow. 

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 

Position: Middle East Sales Controller

Reports to: Head Controlling & Finance, Industrial Region, India, Southeast Asia & Middle East

Job Location: Chinchwad, Pune

 

Job Description:

 As an active member of the sub-region management team, you will:

Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to deliver actionable insights.
Lead initiatives to improve operational efficiency, profitability, and working capital.
Drive budgeting and forecasting processes in coordination with the regional controlling team.
Hold a key role in the finance organization of SKF Eurotrade AB, providing instrumental support to FOC in monthly and annual closings as well as statutory audits.
Ensure compliance with regulatory and internal control standards.
Act as Finance Manager for selected smaller legal entities, such as SKF Pakistan, SKF Egypt, and SKF Saudi Arabia
Oversee credit management across the sub-region.
Continuously challenge and improve existing processes to promote standardization and efficiency.

 

Skills & Experience

CA qualified
Minimum 10+ years of experience in a Finance function.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
Excellent business acumen and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international setting.
Advanced Excel and Power BI skills.
Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
Experience with SKF systems and reporting is an advantage; particularly with platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, BPC and SDW

 

What Makes You Successful

A collaborative team player with strong communication and networking skills.
Open-minded, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement.
High ethical standards and integrity.
Willingness to travel occasionally.

 

At SKF, we are committed to creating a diverse environment and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential to our continued success. Therefore, we focus solely on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are, be yourself. #weareSKF

 

Additional information

The preferred location for this role is Chinchwad, Pune, India

 

Interested candidate/s can share their resume to hema.chaudhary@skf.com

title: Materials Testing Lab Technician
description:
Materials Testing Lab Technician

Location: Falconer, NY

Salary Range: $ 55,000.00 to $ 62,000.00

 

About SKF:  

SKF, reducing friction since 1907, re-imagining rotation for a better tomorrow! 

 

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer that has been a cornerstone in industrial life. Wherever there are machines or products in motion, SKF bearings are there to reduce friction. SKF drives the industries that support our way of life, powers the machines that put food on the table, and even helps explore the cosmos. 

 

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. SKF is on pace to decarbonize all its production facilities by 2030.  

 

We’re guided by our SKF values. Collaboration is critical to the success of our colleagues, partners, and customers. Curiosity and Courage provide a foundation for innovation and advancement. And we do this work out of Care for our people, customers, communities, and the planet.  

 

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.  

 

Learn about SKF at www.skf.com.

 

 

Job Summary:

SKF Aerospace is a first-tier supplier to the global aviation industry and much more. We design & manufacture complex, high-performance, high-value bearings in steel and advanced ceramics. Our production group, technologies, & products are at the heart of the aerospace industry and the world’s leading aircraft jet engine & gearbox manufacturers at our Falconer, NY location.

 

Key Responsibilities:

The analysis includes, but is not limited to:

 

Cleanliness rating, carbide rating, grain size rating, retained austenite measurement, residual stress measurement, hardness measurement, and macro and micro etch.
Computer programming as it pertains to lab efficiency improvements, skills in MS PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Visual Basic.
Maintaining lab cleanliness, reordering supplies, and maintaining lab samples and lab records.

 

Job Requirements:

The position requires a minimum of an Associate Degree or equivalent experience in a technical field. Courses in chemistry, metallurgy, and Heat Treatment are preferred.
Two to three (3) years of experience in engineering or a manufacturing environment. 
Must have the ability to work as part of a team.

 

SKF Aerospace is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to bringing greater diversity to its workforce. Minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

 

 

What You’ll Love About SKF: 

Rest and Relaxation. Enjoy a generous PTO policy and 13 paid holidays. 

 

Work/Life Integration. SKF supports work/life integration, home, family, community, personal well-being, and health.   

 

Diversity in the Workplace.  At SKF, we strive to embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in everything we do. By developing a culture of belonging, our people can flourish, leading to an inclusive, equitable environment that promotes leadership, engagement and innovation.  

 

Best in Class Benefits. SKF cares about the wellbeing of our employees. Comprehensive healthcare options to fit your needs and opt-out payment.  Added benefits include company-paid life insurance, STD, LTD. Supplemental benefits include critical illness coverage, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs, and much more!  

 

Bonus. SKF offers STVS (Short Term Variable Salary) or Sales Incentive based on company performance and at the discretion of management.  

 

Invest in your Future. Participate in our 401K program that boasts a 10% employer contribution: 100% match up to 5% of your elected contribution (100% Vested) plus an additional 5% company contribution.

title: Engineer - Product Engineering Railways
description:

Job Description

Reports To:  Dy. General Manager-Product engineering Railways

Role Type:    Individual Contribution

Location:      Bangalore

To carry out all needed activities for the development of TBU and its related components as a part of product engineering activities
Carry out all needed activities within the portfolio to achieve exceptional results through – personal effectiveness, partnering with others & building customer loyalty fulfilling their needs in an efficient & effective manner.

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or industrial engineering stream.
Candidate should be Good with verbal and written communication and must have a casting background.
Location: Bangalore
5-8 Years of relevant functional work experience, preferably from Railway domain.
Being an individual contributor, the position holder is an epitome of “Doing things correctly” & “Right from me”.
Highly motivated & self-initiator with good communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Ability to work within a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
Ease at dealing with ambiguity in work situations. Take decisions with limited information where necessary and demonstrate confidence in own decisions.

Recover quickly and learn from setbacks.

Able to design and develop components, assemblies considering application requirement
Knowledge on incorporating manufacturing process methodology
Knowledge on form, fit & functions of a product;
Experience in Metrology & Metallurgical activities;
Knowledge in application of measurement principles for manufacturing & other process;
Knowledge on Material behavior properties (Metals. Alloys, castings, Plastics);

Experience in using Advanced search options.

Proficiency in applying GD&T /Geometric Product Specification (GPS)

Knowledge on design standards (ASME, DIN, etc).

title: Factory Warehouse and General Stores Lead
description:
About SKF 

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company sustainable and competitive business excellence.

 

 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms. About the organization: www.skf.com/in

 

SKF Purpose Statement

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow. 

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 

Job Description

 

Job title: Factory Warehouse and General Stores Lead 

Reports to: Head Demand Chain

Role type: People Manager 

Location: Bavla, Ahmedabad (30-35KM from Ahmedabad on Rajkot Road)

 

Purpose of the role: 

Lead and optimize warehouse and general stores operations to ensure uninterrupted manufacturing, efficient inventory management, and alignment with global supply chain and lean manufacturing standards. Drive operational excellence through lean principles, digitalization, and cross-functional collaboration to meet cost, quality, safety, and delivery objectives. 

 

Responsibilities

Ensure uninterrupted availability of indirect materials, tooling, and maintenance spares to support production continuity. 
Collaborate with production, maintenance, and supply chain teams to meet customer delivery requirements in terms of quality, cost, and timelines. 
Drive Lean principles including pull systems (Kanban/JIT), 5S, and waste elimination across warehouse and stores operations. 
Contribute to achieving Zero Accident, Zero Defect, and On-Time Delivery targets. 
Drive productivity improvements and cost optimization initiatives in material handling and storage operations. 
Improve operational efficiency by reducing losses and supporting OEE enhancement. 
Work closely with supply chain to improve service levels and responsiveness. 
Develop and execute improvement roadmaps aligned with business and manufacturing plans. 
Develop and lead a capable workforce through coaching, mentoring, and performance management. 
Support employee engagement and industrial relations initiatives, including interaction with workforce representatives where applicable. 
Manage receipt, storage, inventory control, and line feeding of indirect materials and components. 
Drive inventory optimization by improving inventory turns, reducing obsolescence, and maintaining high inventory accuracy. 
Ensure FIFO/FEFO compliance and effective material traceability. 
Manage teams including, data entry operators, store personnel, and 3PL workforce across shifts. 
Monitor and improve KPIs such as stock control, service levels, and administrative lead times. 
Ensure safe storage practices and adherence to EHS standards within warehouse and stores. 
Define and review inventory norms aligned with strategic and operational requirements. 
Identify obsolete and non-moving inventory and coordinate disposal as per policy. 
Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies. 
Lead digitalization initiatives including ERP/WMS optimization and warehouse automation. 

 

Metrics: 

1) Inventory accuracy and inventory turns 

2) Material availability and downtime due to shortages 

3) 5S audit scores and warehouse compliance 

4) Lean implementation and productivity improvements 

5) Reduction in indirect inventory and obsolescence 

6) Cost optimization of shop supplies and indirect materials 

7) ERP/WMS data accuracy and adherence 

8) Safety performance (zero incidents) 

9) People development and succession readiness 

 

Competencies: 

1. Strong people management and leadership skills 

2. In-depth knowledge of warehouse, inventory, and supply chain processes 

3. Experience with ERP/WMS systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.) 

4. Understanding of lean manufacturing and material flow concepts 

5. Knowledge of financial and cost structures in manufacturing 

6. Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving abilities 

7. Effective interpersonal and communication skills 

8. Experience in handling industrial relations matters 

9. Capability to manage large teams (including blue collar and 3PL workforce) 

10. Ability to drive team development, coaching, and capability building 

 

Candidate Profile: 

1. Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical/Production/Industrial) / Any Graduate, pref. MBA preferred. 

2. 7–12 years of experience in warehouse, stores, or supply chain operations in a manufacturing environment. 

3. Experience in heavy engineering or bearing manufacturing industry preferred. 

4. Proven experience managing large teams including contract and 3PL workforce. 

5. Exposure to lean practices and digital warehouse systems required. 

 

Interested candidate/s can share their resume to hema.chaudhary@skf.com

title: Industrial Engineer Mechatronik / Electro
description:
Are you ready to turn ideas in automation, robotics and industrial control into practical solutions that make production smarter, safer and more efficient?

 

Then you could be our next...

 

Industrial Engineer – Electrical Engineering / IT

 

We are looking for a hands-on and technically strong colleague to join our team at SKF Lubrication Systems CZ in Chodov. In this role, you will work on the design, implementation and development of special-purpose production and testing equipment, with a focus on electrical design, PLC control systems, automation, robotics and digital transformation.

 

You will cooperate closely with internal teams in the Czech Republic and abroad, support quality and production processes, and help us identify and implement new opportunities in automation, robotization and Industry 4.0.

 

Key responsibilities

 

Leads and participates in digital transformation and Industry 4.0 projects (e.g. Digital Assembly Assistant, Pick by Light, condition monitoring and data collection from testing processes) in line with company needs
Takes over know-how for new products and contributes to their optimization from an industrialization perspective, including production, assembly and testing
Collaborates on specifications for electrical test fixtures and test cables and selects suitable electrical components
Designs special-purpose production and testing equipment in terms of electrical systems and PLC control systems (hardware/software), manages implementation projects, communicates with suppliers, and proposes and prepares investment projects
Provides or assists with fault diagnostics for production equipment and products, either internally or through external suppliers, and communicates with solution providers
Identifies opportunities for automation, robotization and digitalization and supports the implementation of specific solutions
Collaborates with the development teams in the Czech Republic, Germany and Sweden, as well as with Quality, on the preparation of test specifications
Maps and maintains an overview of the company’s testing machines, including industrial control systems, installed software and electrical wiring
Builds and develops expertise in areas required for automation, such as industrial machine vision, robots and cobots
Creates electrical schematics and drawings, prepares technical documentation, and contributes to the implementation, creation and development of standards and layouts

 

We expect you to have/be

Secondary or university education in electrical engineering or IT
Professional qualification in electrical engineering pursuant to former Decree No. 50/1978 Coll. or Government Regulation No. 194/2022 Coll
Recommended experience: 5 years with secondary education or 2 years with a university degree
Knowledge of electronic components and their applications
Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and drawings
Familiarity with Siemens industrial control systems, such as SIMATIC and LOGO!
Communicative written and spoken English or German at B1/B2 level; knowledge of both languages is an advantage
Analytical approach and critical thinking, loyalty, independence and responsibility
Willingness to learn and develop in line with company needs 

 

It’s considered meritorious if you also bring:

 

Knowledge of EPLAN or TIA Portal
Knowledge of pneumatics, CNC, Fanuc robots or industrial machine vision
Experience with automation, robotics, digital manufacturing or Industry 4.0 projects

 

 

You will enjoy working here if you are a proactive technical professional who enjoys combining hands-on engineering with project work. You like looking for better solutions, learning new technologies and turning automation ideas into reliable production reality.

 

Our offer

Employment in a stable international company with a long-standing presence in the Czech industrial market
Work in a pleasant environment and a supportive team
An opportunity to contribute to automation, robotics and digital transformation projects with real impact on production

 

 

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself. #weareSKF

 

 

Some additional information

This position will be located in Chodov, Czech Republic.

 

The role may include cooperation with development and implementation teams in the Czech Republic, Germany, Sweden and other locations.

 

Is this you? 

If the answer is yes, please send us your structured CV and motivation letter in English.

title: Praktikant (m/w/d) Produktionslogistik
description:
SKF Marine ist ein weltweit führender Hersteller schiffstechnischer Anlagen, z. B. von Stabilisatoren, Wellenkomponenten oder Ölaufbereitungssystemen (RecondOil). Weiterhin liefern wir Produkte um Meeresenergieanlagen wie z.B. Gezeitenkraftwerke. Unsere Lösungen ermöglichen zuverlässige, intelligente sowie saubere Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die einen reibungslosen Schiffsbetrieb gewährleisten.

 

Wir suchen engagierte Studierende als

 

Praktikant (m/w/d) im Bereich Produktionslogistik (Pflicht und/oder freiwillig)


Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt bei der Planung, Organisation und Umsetzung von Optimierungsprojekten in der Produktionslogistik, beispielsweise im Bereich Lean Management oder bei der Weiterentwicklung von Lager- und Materialflusskonzepten
Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale durch Datenauswertungen, Prozessaufnahmen und Ursachenanalysen
Du wirkst aktiv an der Optimierung logistischer Abläufe innerhalb der Produktion mit und trägst zur Steigerung von Effizienz und Transparenz bei
Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich organisatorische und administrative Aufgaben, beispielsweise die Bearbeitung und Dokumentation von Lieferantenreklamationen
Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen und erhältst Einblicke in das operative und strategische Logistikmanagement

 

Das bringst du mit

Du studierst Logistik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft mit Schwerpunkt Logistik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und hast mindestens das dritte Fachsemester abgeschlossen
Du verfügst über ein analytisches Denkvermögen und hast Interesse an Prozessoptimierungen und datenbasierten Entscheidungen
Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und zuverlässig
Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit und überzeugst durch deine Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
Du hast gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint
Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

 

 

Was bieten wir?
Wir bieten dir neben interessanten Einblicken in unsere Geschäftsprozesse viele spannende Aufgaben, die du zu einem guten Teil selbstständig meistern kannst. Als weltweit tätiges Unternehmen setzen wir auf Vielfalt und auf das Potenzial, das wir daraus schöpfen können – denn deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung liegt uns am Herzen. Ebenfalls bekommst du bei uns:

eine attraktive Vergütung und flexible Arbeitszeiten,
spannende Einblicke in die Produktionslogistik eines internationalen Unternehmens,
die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen,
eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre sowie eine schnelle und strukturierte Einarbeitung,
wertvolle Praxiserfahrung und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

title: Junior Lubrication Technician- Alto Horizonte/GO
description:
Técnico Lubrificação JR

 

A SKF é uma empresa líder de mercado global e estamos há 105 anos no Brasil. Nossa experiência baseia-se no desenvolvimento, no design e na fabricação de rolamentos, vedações e sistemas de lubrificação.

Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia de lubrificação, tem um forte desejo de aprender e deseja contribuir para o sucesso da indústria, nós o convidamos a se candidatar e fazer parte da equipe SKF no nosso cliente em  Alto Horizonte/GO

 

Descrição das atividades

Coletar corretamente amostras de óleos/Emulsões/graxas lubrificantes para análise
Realizar inspeções preventivas observando e avaliando o comportamento do maquinário e do lubrificante;
Efetuar limpeza superficial de componentes externos das unidades hidráulicas e sistemas de lubrificação
Executar e preencher com informações de retorno as Ordens de Trabalho/ Serviço
Executar rotinas de lubrificação com óleo e Graxa
Limpar, ordenar e preparar ferramentas de Lubrificação
Retirar excessos de lubrificantes (Drenar áreas de contenções, remover excesso de graxa)
Avaliar e indicar condições anormais de máquinas e equipamentos (vazamento, temperatura, ruído, contaminação, segurança)
Identificar principais elementos de máquinas e pontos inseridos no plano de lubrificação
Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;
Fazer Limpeza interna de reservatórios hidráulicos e Tanques de alimentação
Lubrificar Componentes com óleos e graxas: Acoplamentos, rolamentos, Mancais de Rolos, Redutores/ Multiplicadores.
Instalar, configurar e trocar lubrificadores automáticos de pontos múltiplos (Series LAGD ou equivalente)
Fazer Análise/ Interpretação dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes dos testes dos lubrificantes e propor ações de correção
Executar exames de campo em óleos (medição de viscosidade; medição de concentração com uso do refratômetro)
Monitorar e testar novos lubrificantes, ferramentas ou sistemas centralizados de lubrificação
Executar trocas parciais de óleos e graxas em equipamentos/ sistemas com lubrificante contaminado

 

Requisitos:

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.
Conhecimento básico de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.
Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação.
Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.
Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Territory Manager

Location: Spokane, Washington

About SKF:  

SKF, reducing friction since 1907, re-imagining rotation for a better tomorrow! 

 

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer that has been a cornerstone in industrial life. Wherever there are machines or products in motion, SKF bearings are there to reduce friction. SKF drives the industries that support our way of life, powers the machines that put food on the table, and even helps explore the cosmos. 

 

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. SKF is on pace to decarbonize all its production facilities by 2030.  

 

We’re guided by our SKF values. Collaboration is critical to the success of our colleagues, partners, and customers. Curiosity and Courage provide a foundation for innovation and advancement. And we do this work out of Care for our people, customers, communities, and the planet.  

 

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.  

 

Learn about SKF at www.skf.com.  

 

Position Summary

The Aftermarket Territory Manager role is accountable for delivering consistent, sustainable, and profitable sales growth by actively creating incremental demand through new business development and competitive share gain. This role requires a strong hunter mentality, with a clear expectation to proactively identify, pursue, and win new opportunities across the territory.

The position engages SKF Authorized Distributors, Channel Partners, and End Users with a primary focus on winning new applications, and converting competitive positions to SKF solutions, while also expanding wallet share within existing accounts through strategic relationship development

Reporting to a regional Sales Director, this highly technical role is responsible for identifying, qualifying, and converting growth opportunities within targeted end users and channel partners. The Territory Manager secures SKF’s position on new products and applications by building a pipeline of new business, executing competitive take-away strategies, and delivering a flawless customer experience. This position serves as the primary technical and commercial resource for distributors and end users in a defined sales territory, partnering cross-functionally to win, implement, and retain business.

Sales territory geography includes Eastern Washington, Northern Idaho, Montana. Subject to future adjustments based on business needs. Candidate must be located within the territory.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Deliver consistent year-over-year sustainable profit growth within the assigned portfolio of business
Short- and long-term strategic goals are achieved by actively managing daily engagement with SKF Authorized Distributors, Channel Partners and end users; driving incremental sales growth through new account penetration, new application wins, competitive conversions, and expansion within existing accounts—supported by relationship building and a flawless customer experience.

 

Build, deepen and sustain customer relationships
Enhance, broaden, and deepen key customer relationships that translate into measurable growth by uncovering unmet needs, qualifying new opportunities, and positioning SKF to take share from incumbent competitors through proactive, consistent customer connection.
Consultative and collaborative approach with customers, their sales teams and engineers to clearly understand customer requirements, assess equipment needs and determine system requirements to provide sales support while enhancing the customer experience
Recommend improved materials or machinery emphasizing the benefits of lower cost or increased production
Recognized by customers as trusted advisor; helping them to achieve their KPI‘s

 

Provide strong technical support to distributor and end-user accounts
Recognized and motivated as the preferred technical partner for distributors and end-user customers in a defined sales area

Effective and strong business management practices:
Proactively identify, qualify, and document new business and share-shift opportunities in the sales funnel aligned to SKF growth strategies (new applications, competitive conversions, and product expansion).
Actively manage the funnel with disciplined cadence (next steps, close plans, and stakeholder maps) to convert targeted prospects and competitive positions into won business while protecting and expanding existing share.
Maintain and establish technical contacts to generate opportunities in the defined sales area
Develops and execute cross-functional go-to-market (GTM) strategy with internal and external stakeholders

 

Strong customer account management practices
Successfully manage end customers with an opportunity-based sales plan designed to protect existing business, win new applications, and execute competitor take-away plans that expand SKF product penetration and wallet share.

Eagerness to look for new opportunities and expand the business – hunter mentality with a bias toward competitive take-away
Ability to answer technical questions utilizing published information catalogs for bearings, seals and maintenance products related, but not limited to:
Nomenclature and design features

Strong technical acumen and ability to learn is a requirement

Strong situational awareness; adept at managing complex organizations and situations
Effectively utilize SKF technology/tools – Illuminate, Microsoft Suite, PTPlace, DeliveryData.net, SKFiOS, Android Applications and Croesus

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.

Summary:

The Aftermarket Territory Manager role is accountable for delivering consistent, sustainable, and profitable sales growth by actively creating incremental demand through new business development and competitive share gain. The position engages SKF Authorized Distributors, Channel Partners, and End Users with a primary focus on winning new applications, and converting competitive positions to SKF solutions, while also expanding wallet share within existing accounts through strategic relationship development

Reporting to a regional Sales Director, this highly technical role is responsible for identifying, qualifying, and converting growth opportunities within targeted end users and channel partners. The Territory Manager secures SKF’s position on new products and applications by building a pipeline of new business, executing competitive take-away strategies, and delivering a flawless customer experience. This position serves as the primary technical and commercial resource for distributors and end users in a defined sales territory, partnering cross-functionally to win, implement, and retain business.

Sales territory geography includes Wisconsin. Subject to future adjustments based on business needs. Candidate must be located within the territory.

Deliver consistent year-over-year sustainable profit growth within the assigned portfolio of business

PLM Product Manager

 

 

In this role you are responsible for defining and executing the strategy, roadmap, and business value realization of the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) platform. You act as the bridge between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Service, and IT, ensuring that product data and processes are managed effectively throughout the entire product lifecycle.

The PLM Product Manager guide the evolution of PLM capabilities, enabling digital continuity, improved engineering efficiency, product data quality, and seamless integration with enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, CAD, Requirements Management, and Design Automation solutions. In this role you will ensure that investments in PLM deliver measurable business outcomes and support the company's digital transformation strategy.

 

Key Responsibilities

Define and maintain the PLM product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap.
Align PLM investments with business objectives, business priorities, and digital transformation initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through enhanced PLM capabilities.
Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies in PLM, Digital Thread, Digital Twin, AI, and Model-Based Engineering.
Translate business requirements into product features, epics, and user stories.
Balance strategic initiatives, technical debt, and enhancement requests.
Work with development teams, architects, and vendors to deliver roadmap and ensure understanding of business priorities and expected outcomes.
Facilitate workshops to capture business requirements and define future-state processes; develop communication, training, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
Build alignment among stakeholders and facilitate decision-making across multiple business functions.
Present roadmap progress, risks, and business benefits to leadership teams.
Drive user adoption and organizational readiness.measure it and continuously improve user experience.

 

 

Required Qualifications

 

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field.
A few years of experience in a Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Architect, or similar strategic role
Several years of experience in Product Lifecycle Management, Engineering Systems, Product Data Management, or Digital Engineering.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale PLM transformation initiatives.
Experience with one or more PLM platforms (Windchill, Teamcenter, SAP) and with ERP integration (SAP preferred).
Experience with Manufacturing Engineering and MES integrations.
Knowledge of CAD integrations (Creo, NX, CATIA, SolidWorks).
Understanding of cloud-based architectures and enterprise integrations.
Certifications in SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner, Agile Product Management, or PLM-related domains.

 

 

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself. #weareSKF

 

 

You will enjoy working here if you (are/have) experience working with global and cross-functional stakeholders.

You will report to the Manager, Product Development Solutions, who is located in Bangalore (India). title: CAD Engineer R&D (SE)
description:
Výrobní závod švédské společnosti SKF AB, největšího světového výrobce ložisek, těsnění, maziv a mazacích systémů, produktů mechatroniky, výrobků pro přenos výkonu a dodavatele široké škály technickoinženýrských služeb, působící na českém průmyslovém trhu od roku 1919, přijme do svého týmu pracovníka na pozici:

CAD Engineer R&D (SE)

Místo pracoviště: Vintířovská 1169, 357 35 Chodov, Česká republika

Náplň práce:

Vytvářet a udržovat 3D CAD modely a detailní 2D technické výkresy pro produkty, sestavy a komponenty SKF.
Podporovat projekty vývoje nových produktů od fáze konceptu až po uvolnění do sériové výroby.
Připravovat přesnou výrobní dokumentaci, včetně výkresů, kusovníků (BOM), technických specifikací a montážních instrukcí.
Provádět konstrukční úpravy a technické změny na základě iniciativ zaměřených na zlepšování produktů, požadavků zákazníků a zpětné vazby z výroby.
Zajišťovat, aby návrhy splňovaly technické standardy SKF, mezinárodní normy a požadavky zákazníků.
Spolupracovat s mezioborovými týmy, včetně oddělení vývoje produktů, výroby, nákupu, kvality a dodavatelského řetězce.
Účastnit se konstrukčních revizí a podporovat hodnocení rizik během procesu vývoje.
Podporovat vývoj prototypů, testovací aktivity a validaci produktů poskytováním technické dokumentace a technické podpory.
Podílet se na iniciativách zaměřených na snižování nákladů, hodnotové inženýrství (Value Engineering) a neustálé zlepšování.
Pomáhat při standardizaci komponentů, konstrukčních metodik a inženýrských postupů.
Poskytovat technickou podporu výrobním závodům a globálním inženýrským týmům SKF.

Požadujeme:

Technické vzdělání v oboru strojírenství, průmyslového designu, mechatroniky, CAD konstrukce nebo příbuzném technickém oboru (střední průmyslová škola, odborné vzdělání nebo odpovídající praxe).
Praktické zkušenosti v oblasti CAD konstrukce nebo strojního navrhování.
Znalost 3D CAD softwaru, jako jsou SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor, CATIA, NX nebo obdobné systémy.
Znalost systému SAP, zejména v oblastech (výhodou):
správa kmenových dat materiálů,
správa kusovníků (BOM),
procesy řízení technických změn.
Dobrá znalost technické výkresové dokumentace, GD&T (geometrických tolerancí a tolerování), tolerancí a standardů technické dokumentace.
Znalost výrobních procesů (obrábění, montáž, lisování/vstřikování, odlévání).
Schopnost pracovat se strukturovanými daty a dodržovat standardizované procesy.
Dobré komunikační dovednosti a schopnost spolupráce v mezioborových týmech.
Vysoká míra pečlivosti a orientace na kvalitu.
Znalost anglického (preferováno) nebo německého jazyka.
Pozice vhodná i pro absolventy (SŠ/VŠ).

Nabízíme:

zaměstnání ve stabilní společnosti, čistém a moderním prostředí
práci ve vstřícném kolektivu a přátelské atmosféře
příspěvek na stravování a dopravu
E-benefity
Roční odměna STVS

V případě, že Vás tato nabídka zaujala, prosím, zašlete nám Váš strukturovaný životopis a motivační dopis v českém jazyce na e-mail:    pavla.zemanova@skf.com

description:
SKF Marine ist ein weltweit führender Hersteller schiffstechnischer Anlagen, z. B. von Stabilisatoren, Wellenkomponenten oder Ölaufbereitungssystemen (RecondOil). Mitarbeiter Lager & Transport (m/w/d)

Ein- und Auslagertätigkeiten von Klein- bzw. Großbauteilen mittels Schmalgang- und Gegengewichtsstapler sowie sicherer Umgang mit einem Handscanner zum Quittieren der Fahr- und Lageraufträge
Transporttätigkeiten zur Fertigungsversorgung per Gegengewichtstapler, Schwerlaststapler (16 Tonnen) und Schwerlastanhängern (bis zu 40 Tonnen)
Transporttätigkeiten mittels Brückenkran (bis zu 130 Tonnen)
Unterstützung bei Inventuren (physische Zählung) und der Bearbeitung von Klärungsfällen

Erfolgreich abgeschlossene fachspezifische Berufsausbildung, z. B. zur Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik bzw. zum Fachlageristen (m/w/d), eine vergleichbare Qualifikation oder eine fachfremde Berufsausbildung samt einschlägiger Berufserfahrung als Logistiker / Lagerist (m/w/d)
Gabelstaplerschein, Kranschein (flurbediente Brückenkrane) sowie das Zertifikat „Anschlagen von Lasten“
IT- Affinität und UVV- Kenntnisse (zwingend erforderlich)
Erfahrung im Umgang mit einem Self-Propelled Modular Transporter (SPMT) oder anderen Schwerlasttransport-Systemen von Vorteil
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie eine sorgfältige und konzentrierte Arbeitsweise

Unbefristete Anstellung mit einer attraktiven Vergütung (Tarifvertrag Metall- und Elektroindustrie), 35-Stunden-Woche, 30 Urlaubstage, JobRad, Hansefit, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

title: Research Technician - Seal Testing
description:
SKF is a global leader in products and services for rotating equipment. Within SKF Sealing Solutions, the Global Research & Innovation team generates the fundamental knowledge and technologies that enable next-generation sealing systems.

 

About the team

Based at SKF’s research centre in Houten, the Netherlands, our team develops advanced characterisation, simulation and testing capabilities that support product development, drive digital transformation and contribute to more sustainable sealing solutions. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a:

 

Research Technician – Seal Testing

 

The role

You will be part of our seal testing team, working alongside experienced research engineers and laboratory specialists and contributing to research and development projects for a wide range of sealing systems.

This is a varied, hands-on role in which you will prepare and perform tests, analyse results and help improve our products but also laboratory equipment and methods.

 

Your responsibilities

Prepare seal samples and perform preliminary analyses before testing.
Conduct established tests to evaluate seal performance, including friction, wear, contamination ingress, leakage and service life.
Analyse, document and present test results.
Contribute to the design and development of new test components, systems and methods.
Take ownership of designated laboratory equipment and ensure it is used in compliance with health and safety requirements.
Perform routine maintenance and calibrate laboratory equipment.
Maintain stock levels of laboratory supplies.
Improve laboratory equipment, methods and working practices.

 

What we are looking for

MBO+ level technical education or a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related discipline.
Two to five years of hands-on experience in mechanical testing and experimental verification, preferably involving rotating equipment such as bearings or seals.
Experience with CAD software such as PTC Creo is a plus.
Knowledge of electrical or electronic circuits and/or mechatronics is an advantage.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365.
A proactive and practical approach.
A quality-focused mindset and a drive for continuous improvement.
Very good spoken and written English.
Eagerness to learn and develop.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

 

What we offer

You will join a modern international R&D environment within a globally recognized engineering company. This role offers a unique opportunity to combine hands-on laboratory work with participation in the development of next-generation sealing technologies.

You will work with advanced testing equipment, collaborate with experienced researchers and engineers, and contribute to projects that support customers and industries worldwide. Through close interaction with teams across SKF, you will gain exposure to international research and product development activities.

We are committed to your professional growth and offer opportunities to learn, develop new skills and expand your technical expertise, supported by a competitive compensation and benefits package.

SKF is committed to diversity and inclusion. We value your skills, experience and potential. Come as you are and be yourself. #weareSKF

 

Interested?

If you are passionate about technology, innovation and hands-on testing, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of sealing solutions and contribute to technologies that make industries around the world more efficient and sustainable.



Please submit your application and CV in English no later than 2 October 2026. We review applications continuously and encourage early applications.

To ensure a fair and inclusive recruitment process, assessments and background checks may form part of the selection procedure, subject to local laws.

title: Application Engineer
description:
Application Engineer

Location: Saskatchewan 

Salary Range: $ 82,000.00 to $ 92,000.00 CAN

 

About SKF:

SKF, reducing friction since 1907, re-imagining rotation for a better tomorrow!

 

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer that has been a cornerstone in industrial life. Wherever there are machines or products in motion, SKF bearings are there to reduce friction. SKF drives the industries that support our way of life, powers the machines that put food on the table, and even helps explore the cosmos.

 

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. SKF is on pace to decarbonize all its production facilities by 2030.

 

We’re guided by our SKF values. Collaboration is critical to the success of our colleagues, partners, and customers. Curiosity and Courage provide a foundation for innovation and advancement. And we do this work out of Care for our people, customers, communities, and the planet.

 

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.

 

Learn about SKF at www.skf.com.

 

Position Summary

This role offers the opportunity to work directly with customers across a wide range of industries, helping them improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and solve complex operational challenges. From troubleshooting critical equipment issues to supporting major reliability improvement initiatives, no two days are the same.

As an Application Engineer with SKF, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, working closely with customers, sales teams, and reliability professionals.

This position is home-based, with travel to customer locations across Saskatchewan and Manitoba (approximately 50% of the time), covering some of Canada's most important industrial operations, including mining, agriculture, manufacturing, and food processing. Occasional travel outside of these provinces may also be required.  The successful candidate must reside in Saskatchewan.

 

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical support in the areas of product selection, application review, installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, quality, and root cause failure analysis.
Conduct customer site visits to investigate equipment issues, perform inspections, support installations, and identify opportunities for reliability improvement.
Establish strong technical relationships with customers, positioning SKF as the preferred partner for reliability and rotating equipment solutions.
Identify and develop innovative, high-value solutions that address customer challenges, improve operational performance, and create measurable value.
Develop and deliver technical training programs for customers and internal personnel.
Collaborate across multiple teams, including customer service, sales and reliability, to achieve the company’s goals.

 

Qualifications

Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent education.
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation with APEGS, or eligibility to obtain registration within a reasonable period of employment.
3 years experience in engineering, reliability, maintenance, rotating equipment, technical sales support, or industrial applications.
Strong mechanical aptitude and hands-on problem-solving skills.
Excellent customer service, communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.
Proven track record of proactive continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, solve complex technical problems, and create value for customers.

 

Travel Requirements

50% travel required

 

What You’ll Love About SKF:

Rest and Relaxation. Enjoy a generous PTO policy and 13 paid holidays.

 

Work/Life Integration. SKF supports work/life integration, home, family, community, personal well-being and health. Flexible work options available, depending on role.

 

Diversity in the Workplace. At SKF, we strive to embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in everything we do. By developing a culture of belonging, our people can flourish; leading to an inclusive, equitable environment that promotes leadership, engagement and innovation.

 

Best in Class Benefits. SKF cares about the wellbeing of our employees. Comprehensive healthcare options to fit your needs and opt out payment.  Added benefits include company paid life insurance, STD, LTD. Supplemental benefits include critical illness coverage, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs, and much more!

 

Bonus. SKF offers STVS (Short Term Variable Salary) or Sales Incentive based on company performance and at the discretion of management.

 

Invest in your Future. Participate in our 401K program that boasts a 10% employer contribution:  100% match up to 5% of your elected contribution (100% Vested) plus an additional 5% company contribution.

title: Engineering Manager

Continuous survey of all manufacturing operations to determine areas for process improvements and cost reductions.
Establishes engineering, equipment and tooling standards for more efficient application of the Company’s resources.
Reviews and recommend design changes to new product designs to develop the best design with the lowest cost.
Manages the design/coordinates the manufacture and run-off production machines/machine elements.  New or re-furbished equipment.
Provides engineering advice, complies data and determines probable costs for process improvement projects.
Maintains an effective record filing/retrieval system for the purpose of future reference.
Manages engineers and suppliers to ensure schedules and quality of work are maintained.

Plans and schedules activities, sets objectives with subordinates and ensures that goals are met.  Delegates to subordinate the responsibility and authority necessary for the department to function effectively but retains overall responsibility and accountability for results.  Supply all necessary directions to subordinates regarding work objectives.  Provides training and development opportunities for subordinates to develop their technical and managerial skills.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering

 

Experience: Ten years of Engineering Experience, preferably in machining and assembly environment. Preferably 3+ years in leadership role.

Other Requirements: MUST be a US citizen or a Green Card holder. Ability to motivate and direct an engineering/ technical staff and possess proven supervisory and leadership skills.  Ability to communicate at all levels of the organization.

0% - 10% of travel

Performance management guidance and communication

Communicate updates and process changes in a simple, clear, and timely way in line with Group PX CoE direction

Confidence using digital tools and systems, with a practical approach to solving issues and improving routines
Structured way of working, good attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership

Fluency in English

description:
About SKF

 

SKF is the world leading supplier of products and solutions in the bearing business including technical support, maintenance services, condition monitoring and training.

The inherent skills and competence of our around 40,000 employees help us to fulfill our objective of creating more intelligent, sustainable and innovative customer solutions. SKF is a truly global company with presence in more than 130 countries, serving an extensive range of industries and customers worldwide. SKF started its operations in India in 1923.

 

SKF has hands-on experience in over 40 industries with knowledge and a vast product portfolio across the SKF technology platforms: bearings and units, seals, lubrication systems, condition monitoring equipment, and services.

 

We operate in four regions – the Americas, Europe, Middle East & Africa, India & Southeast Asia and China & Northeast Asia – to serve customers with speed and responsiveness.

 

SKF has been in India since more than 100 years and has a pan India footprint consisting of 6 manufacturing facilities, 12 offices, a supplier network of over 300 distributors and an employee base of more than 2600 dedicated professionals.

 

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in

 

 

Innovation is the key:

We make some of the world’s most innovative products and solutions to reduce friction. But we sell something bigger. Less friction means more energy saved. And it means that society can move forward to a more energy-efficient future where we can all do more with less.

 

Sustainability:

At SKF, we have a long history of working with industrial sustainability. It is an integral part of what we do every day. And we strive to create engagement throughout the business, not only by implementing sustainability on a strategic level, but also by encouraging the ideas and grass root projects initiated by our people around the world.

 

About Technology Development

The TD team for ISEA is focused on Customer Product development & Engineering, Innovation for the region, rollout of new technologies for the region, testing, Failure Investigation, scaleup from POC to series production, Portfolio Management etc.

 

TD Competencies

 

Engineering & Research Centre
Product Development & Engineering – This division brings out conceptual/detailed designs to support BOH/ETO activities based on customer specifications. Technology trends like digitization of workflows, e- Aviation, Sensorization, Product localization, Design automation, Agile, DFX and Model based designs, (MBDs) have increased the operational efficiency and application productivity. What our customer gain from this is efficient digital data exchange, traceability and flexibility in design changes, reduced carbon footprint and higher performance products.
Testing: Group Testing Services is a trusted partner in design, process and supplier validation. The testing team ensures greater focus on customer requirements, quality and operational efficiency. This entails greater support for SKF’s processes in a faster manner by applying global test standards, adapted to local customer specific requirements.
Global Metallurgy & Chemistry Laboratory (GMC)
Future Factory (Manufacturing 4.0) – Working on World class manufacturing – Lean, Green, Digital.
Manufacturing Process & Development - We support factories in the areas of process development (Heat treatment), machine building, Advanced Manufacturing – HT simulations, Additive Manufacturing, Vision Inspection etc. We are working on building innovative solutions on machines (measurement/ assembly/ clean manufacturing) and focusing on Scaling technologies like 3D printing and Camera based Inspection system with automation.
Connected Technologies- develop new products for connectivity and sustain it. We work on sensor technology and data integration. This help customer for predictive maintenance of their assets

 

 

SKF Purpose Statement

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

title: Operations and Supply chain Manager
description:
About SKF

 

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

 

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in

 

 

SKF Purpose Statement

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 

JOB DESCRIPTION

 

Position Title:       Operations & Supply Chain Manager, Services

Role Type:             Individual Contribution  

Location:               Pune

 

Job Responsibilities

The Operational Manager will be responsible for end-to-end supply chain operations including procurement of manpower services, site specific material, Inventory management, demand planning, supplier management, and customer service. Ensuring effective coordination between site teams, suppliers, and supply chain functions to enable uninterrupted service execution and drive operational efficiency to support business growth

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Manpower Services Procurement

Identify, evaluate, and onboard manpower service vendors for service sites across multiple customer locations.

Conduct vendor capability, compliance, and commercial evaluations.

Negotiate commercial terms and finalize manpower service contracts.

Coordinate with Legal for contract vetting, CMS uploading, and timely execution.

Manage contract-related issues and resolve vendor conflicts to ensure continuity of operations.

Ensure compliance with statutory, labor, and contractual requirements.

 

Spares & Consumables Procurement

Identify and develop suppliers for spares and consumables required for site service operations.

Coordinate with site and engineering teams to understand material requirements.

Negotiate pricing, delivery terms, and service levels with suppliers.

Monitor supplier performance on cost, quality, and availability.

IMS / Inventory / VMI Support (Coordination Role)

Support IMS contracts including Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) in coordination with site teams, customer service and SKF distributors.

Monitor stock levels, consumption trends, and replenishment cycles.

Review inventory accuracy between physical stock and SAP records.

Support monitoring of IMS KPIs such as stock availability and service fill rate through coordination with site operations.

 

Customer Service & Supply Chain Transaction Monitoring

Monitor job-related service transactions including material issue and consumption.

Track procurement, inventory, and service transactions in SAP systems.

Coordinate with Service Execution, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure transactional accuracy and timely closures.

Identify transaction gaps or delays and support resolution with operational teams.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical preferred) or Commerce / Management.

5-7 years of experience in procurement, service contracts, or supply chain roles within industrial / steel / heavy engineering environments.

Strong experience in manpower service contracting and vendor negotiations.

Hands-on exposure to SAP systems for procurement, inventory, and service transactions.

Experience working across multiple customer locations and stakeholders.

 

 

Interested candidates can share their resume to : prachi.chourasia@skf.com

Purpose of the role

 

Execute operational purchasing of DM/IDM&S to support country/factories. Support the implementation of strategic sourcing results in the country/factories and promote operational efficiency in the countries. Work closely with the internal stakeholders and execute local purchasing activities. Implement contracts, agreements, and new processes. Participate in and develop efficient standardized P2P processes.

Manage supplier development activities in SKF globally on demand. Manage the supplier development resources and deploy them to run supplier development projects at prioritized suppliers. Manage projects related to quality system development.

Carry out local operational purchasing activities, such as issuing purchase orders and following up on orders and invoices. Enter and maintain purchasing data in purchasing data warehouses, purchasing databases, e-procurement and purchasing systems. 

 

Responsibilities-

Manager – Factory Purchase

Perform local purchasing according to defined strategy and frameworks:

Negotiate and sign local agreements up to a regionally defined and agreed upon value,
Review purchase requisitions and identify sources of supply for spot buys,
Advice internal stakeholders on procurement issues, providing support and guidance at all stages of the procurement cycle,
Advise customers on modifications from original requests (if alternative, more cost efficient, or otherwise beneficial alternatives exist),
Select contract/supplier to fill requisitions in accordance with defined strategy and agreements.

 

Participate as required in global and regional strategic sourcing Projects:

Provide local market data and information to global strategic sourcing teams,
Validate completeness and relevance of RFI/RFP,
Participate in the evaluation and selection of suppliers,
Work in close collaboration with Global Category Managers, as well as end users, to ensure local acceptance and implementation of sourcing strategy,
Actively participate in the validation of the sourcing strategy implementation approach,
Actively participate in the implementation of new contracts,
Track key performance indicators on supplier and internal customer contract compliance,
Define and take corrective actions to improve contracts compliance.

 

Drive local sourcing initiatives:

Perform local sourcing activities for relatively low spend,
Perform local market analysis, and define appropriate sourcing strategy,
Screening, short list and select potential suppliers through a Request for Information (RFI) & Request for Proposal (RFP) process,
Develop negotiation strategy and lead supplier negotiations,
Work with end user and supplier in order to resolve issues,
Continuously track supplier performance according to defined QCDIM,
Initiate and conduct supplier evaluations and supplier audits.
Support implementation of new processes and systems, QCDIM, CSR & sustainability requirements.
Run their operations according to the SKF Code of Conduct, Environment Health & Safety (EHS), and Quality Policies, and work according to the SKF Quality Management System. If the operation is EHS certified, work according to the SKF EHS Management System.

 

Purchasing Administration Activities:

Perform local purchasing according to defined strategies and frameworks.
Handle invoice price deviations.
Release POs from special requests.
Upload new suppliers in vendor master.
Generate purchasing orders form approved requisitions.
Process purchase orders not transacted electronically.
Provide feedback to requestors if incorrectness occurs.
Work with suppliers to resolve issues related to invoices, damaged/returned goods, and delivery performance.
File and update agreements and relevant documentation in designated repositories, update prices and supplier information in databases etc
Chase suppliers if price lists are not updated as per contractual agreements (mainly for direct material).
Check all price lists received from suppliers are in line with agreements.
Distribute price lists to Global Category Managers after checking for validation.
Once validated, distribute them to Suppliers lists as agreed with Global Category Managers.
Support to develop and implement purchasing processes and systems.
Group Reporting (MMRO)
KPI Updating
Ariba/ Star Ariba Database updation

 

Supplier Development Activities:

Oversee developing, implementing and ensuring consistency of best practice processes for Supplier Development. The process includes making an assessment at a supplier site of lean management practices, production efficiency, quality management processes, delivery management, etc. and to define key performance gaps. Then, work with the supplier to define an improvement program to close the gaps and provide support during the execution of the program.
Drive supplier development work based on input from the sourcing teams and PL/BU’s; guide, support, coach, train the Supplier Development engineers.

 

SQA Activities:

Can flexibly act as SQA to support Category or BU specific needs as per Global SQA directions

 

Key Interfaces / Interactions In the Job:

Suppliers
Customers
Engineering Function
Manufacturing  
Group Purchasing
Project Management
Quality Assurance

 

Competencies

Good Technical Knowledge about engineering drawing, Manufacturing processes.
Good Project Management skills.
Team Management
Quality system knowledge.
APQP /PPAP/IATF and other quality system requirements.
Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management
Problem-solving and analytical thinking
Excellent communication and negotiation skills

 

Candidate Profile:

12-15 years in supplier development, Product development, Project Management, Purchase and supply chain management.
BE Mechanical (Mechanical, Industrial, Production or equivalent) (Full time).
MBA, PMP and other certifications should be Preferable.

Summary:

This position is responsible for the repair and maintenance of mechanical and hydraulic components of production machines and equipment such as metal fabricating, machine tools, material-handling system and automated lubrication system, assuring that equipment and machinery are in proper operating condition to maximize production and minimize down time.  This position is also responsible for general building maintenance.

 

Duties and Responsibilities (included but not limited to):

Complete periodic machine tool preventive maintenance to ensure machine availability and reliability performance.
Troubleshoot, repair and overhaul electrical/mechanical systems like pumps, gearboxes, ball screws, slide assemblies and other drive mechanisms.
Knowledge of all standard measuring equipment including the proper use of micrometers, calipers and dial indicators.
Ability to complete fabrication projects from drawings by using tool room equipment, such as engine lathe, milling machine, drill press and welding equipment.
Perform installation and set-up of new equipment as necessary.
Operate forklift when required.
Must be able to work with CMMS system to record work orders and preventative maintenance schedules.
Responsible for maintaining a clean and safe environment including identification of unsafe conditions. 
May perform diagnosis/repair on low voltage and control circuits (less than 240 VAC).
May disassemble and assemble electrical wires, connections, conduit, motors, controls, etc. on de-energized machinery/equipment and facility.
Performs continuous improvement (lean) activities as may be assigned or required.
Performs other duties and assignments as scheduled and/or required.

 

Requirements and Qualifications:

Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in a manufacturing environment performing repairs to machinery, basic equipment and general facility maintenance.
High School Diploma or GED minimum. 
Experience with CNC machine repair is highly preferred.
Must possess a high degree of mechanical aptitude and the ability to work with hand tools (welding, wrenches, etc.) in mechanically oriented situations. 
Good working knowledge of plumbing, electrical, construction, hydraulics, and pneumatics.
Ability to read, write and to follow detailed written instructions. 
Ability to lift up to 40 pounds, stand, sit, bend and move freely about the plant.
At a minimum, steel toed or composite shoes and ANSI approved safety glasses with side shields are required.
Hourly employees will be a part of the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers, Lodge 475

Rest and Relaxation. Enjoy a robust vacation policy and 13 paid holidays!

 

Health and Wellness Benefits. SKF cares about the wellbeing of our employees. Many options for best in class medical and dental plans to fit your needs; a wellness plan that includes biometric screening and health risk assessment for you and your spouse and incentives for healthy living!

 

Invest in your Future. SKF offers amazing retirement options! Participate in our 401K program that boasts of a per pay defined contribution of 7% of your gross earnings with a one-year vesting requirement.

 

Much more! Growth opportunities, voluntary critical illness coverage, voluntary legal plan, employee assistance program, life insurance, vehicle discount programs, mobile phone discounts, and with so many benefits to working for SKF, we could not name them all!

Location: Muskegon, MI

Immatrikulation in Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Informatik o. Ä.

Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit.

Role Title:            Internal Control Manager

Reports to:           Head of Internal Control

Role Type:            Stakeholders Management

Job Location:       Chinchwad, Pune

 

Internal Control within Risk and Assurance is responsible for maintaining and enhancing the control environment across SKF Industrial to ensure accurate and reliable financial reporting. 

As Internal Control Manager, you will support the Head of Internal Control and contribute to the development, implementation, and monitoring of internal control frameworks. 

You will be part of a global team and collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization.

Mission

The Internal Control function sets the strategy and direction for internal control over financial reporting in SKF Industrial. 

As Internal Control Manager, you will help translate this strategy into operational execution, ensuring controls are effectively designed, implemented, and monitored.

You will support process development, risk-based control adaptation, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aligned with policies, directives, and regulatory requirements.

Main activities and responsibilities

As Internal Control Manager, your key responsibilities include:

Support the development and maintenance of group-wide internal control requirements
Assist in the implementation and follow-up of controls across business processes
Coordinate and execute internal control testing activities
Contribute to the development and enhancement of the internal control framework and tool, ServiceNow IRM
Monitor compliance with internal control policies and procedures
Collaborate with process owners to ensure control design and effectiveness
Participate in risk assessments and identify control gaps
Prepare reports and updates for management and relevant committees
Promote awareness and understanding of internal control principles across the organization
Deliver training and guidance to stakeholders as needed
Be part and contribute with internal control expertise in global and/or regional projects

 

 Critical competencies for the position

You hold CA or CMA / MBA finance degree in finance and have at least 8 years of experience in Internal Control or Financial Reporting. Experience in an audit firm or a multinational organization is considered an advantage.

The preferred candidate has a solid background in both governance and hands-on execution within finance or accounting. You demonstrate strong collaboration skills and a supportive approach, and you are effective at building professional relationships across functions and geographies.

In this role, you will need a proactive mindset and experience working in both project-based and process-oriented environments. You are comfortable operating in a decentralized organization and bring a high level of integrity to your work.

To succeed, you are solution-oriented with a strong attention to detail and a focus on practical execution. You bring analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and a can-do attitude. Strong communication skills are essential, including the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at various levels, in both written and spoken English.

Pricing Performance Management

Own the regional pricing performance management framework and governance process.

Establish, monitor, and drive achievement of pricing KPIs related to revenue, margin, price realization, and profitability.

Lead regular business reviews with commercial and pricing leaders to assess performance against targets.

Identify performance gaps and drive corrective actions with accountable stakeholders.

Escalate risks and barriers impacting pricing performance and ensure timely resolution.

Track execution of agreed actions and measure business impact.

Pricing Strategy Execution & Value Realization

Drive implementation and adoption of pricing strategies across countries and business units.

Partner with sales, product management, and finance teams to ensure pricing initiatives translate into measurable revenue and margin improvement.

Monitor realization of approved pricing actions and intervene when results fall below expectations.

Lead initiatives to improve pricing discipline, compliance, and commercial effectiveness.

Ensure pricing decisions align with strategic growth and profitability objectives.

Reporting, Governance & Decision Support

Own executive pricing dashboards, scorecards, and performance review processes.

Establish and enforce standardized pricing metrics and reporting methodologies across regions.

Drive a single source of truth for pricing, profitability, and realization performance.

Provide leadership with performance-based recommendations and clear actions required to achieve targets.

Lead governance forums and facilitate decision-making on pricing priorities and performance improvement opportunities.

Profitability & Deal Governance

Own profitability monitoring across customers, products, and commercial segments.

Identify margin erosion, pricing leakage, and unprofitable business trends and drive remediation plans.

Partner with commercial teams to improve deal profitability and pricing discipline.

Review strategic pricing and commercial decisions to ensure alignment with profitability objectives.

Drive accountability for margin improvement commitments and targeted outcomes.

Price Increase Management

Own tracking and governance of annual and strategic price increase programs.

Monitor realization of SPR, ARC, and List Price initiatives and ensure delivery of planned outcomes.

Challenge regions and commercial teams on exception management and realization performance.

Lead analysis and action planning to improve customer adoption and reduce value leakage.

Support development and execution of annual pricing strategies to maximize realization and profitability.

Forecasting & Business Planning

Own pricing forecasts and profitability outlooks for the region.

Develop scenario models to support pricing decisions, investment priorities, and business planning.

Quantify risks and opportunities and recommend actions required to achieve financial targets.

Partner with Finance and Commercial leadership to incorporate pricing performance into business forecasts and operating plans.

Data Governance & Continuous Improvement

Own pricing data governance standards and KPI definitions.

Drive data quality improvement initiatives to strengthen decision-making and business confidence.

Partner with system administrators and business stakeholders to address data integrity issues and process gaps.

Lead automation and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance pricing effectiveness, transparency, and responsiveness.

 

Key Accountabilities

Delivery of pricing realization targets.

Achievement of regional margin improvement objectives.

Reduction of pricing leakage and margin erosion.

Successful execution of price increase programs.

Forecast accuracy for pricing and profitability performance.

Compliance with pricing governance and reporting standards.

Closure of identified performance gaps through measurable corrective actions.

Adoption and execution of pricing initiatives across countries and business units.

Job Summary

Construct and repair production machines and parts, working from prints, sketches, and/or damaged parts, maintaining close tolerances, dismantling and assembling machines, as necessary.
Selecting, setting up, and operating various metalworking machines using precision measuring and gauging equipment.
Machining parts from prints or sketches.
Emergency production tooling as required.
Gauging, bearing disassembly not involving normal assembly equipment.
Will be required to join local UAW union. 

 

Skilled trades will train employees outside classification by mutual agreement between the union and company based on business needs. Journeymen will train other journeymen and apprentices.

 

Physical Demands

Stooping, climbing, lifting, walking, using hoists, rollers, hand trucks, climbing up and down ladders, aerial platforms, accessing confined spaces, etc.

 

Working Conditions: Inside and outside, etc.

 

Uncontrollable Hazards: Surface cuts possible while handling parts and equipment.

 

Safety of Others: Standard. Pertinent safety equipment (i.e. hearing protection, safety glasses, gloves, respiratory protection, etc.).

 

Working Procedure

Receive assignment from supervisor stating machine, machine location and diagnosed trouble; secure manufacturer's print and/or engineering sketch or drawing pertaining to machine construction and alterations.
Remove defective or worn parts at machine location or disassemble machine in Machine Shop when general overhaul is indicated with assistance of helper as assigned.
Repair/replace internal components related to Heat Treat Furnace equipment, including internal and external load/unload systems and internal cell maintenance/repair.
Determine, with assistance of supervisor, extent of repair required to place machine in first-class operating condition; decide whether parts are to be repaired or replaced.
Secure required material per requisitions from supervisor; secure fixtures and tools required to set up metalworking machines to machine new parts and/or repair worn parts to specifications according to prescribed methods.
Form and sharpen tools required to process parts according to specified requirements.
Work with engineering and operators to set speeds and feeds according to size and type of material, operation to be performed, stock to be removed and finish requirement.
Position tools in holders, work in fixture, start machine and engage feed or manually feed tool to work.
Measure dimensions of work at intervals to ensure metal is being removed according to specified dimensions and tolerances using varied measuring devices.
Reassemble machine and test repair accuracy by observing starting, running and stopping cycles.
Removal, repair and/or replacement of machine-mounted pumps.
Make and install special equipment or arrange special adaptations in production machines per instructions and according to specifications prepared by the Engineering Department.
Perform electric arc welding (MIG, TIG, Stick), plumbing, etc., as part of machine repair/modification.
Work in conjunction with outside machine repair technicians to resolve machine issues.
Clean and lubricate machines after each use.
Hand scrape machine ways.
Clean and maintain personal work areas as well as the department.
Other duties as assigned.

Dedicated, full-time hourly resources responsible for a specific area.
Focuses on defined and quantified levels of achievement.
Driver of lean manufacturing initiatives (pillars) and a leader of cultural change.
Trainer and facilitator for continuous improvement activities within their area.
Perform audits on achievements to verify and ensure sustainability.
Develop and implement recognition programs for an area's achievements.
