title: Assistant Manager-Transportation
description:
About SKF

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

 

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

About the organization: www.skf.com/in

 

SKF Purpose Statement

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 

 

Job Title:            Asst. Manager Transportation

Reports to:         Manager Warehousing & Transportation

Role Type:          Individual Contributor

Location:            Chakan , Pune 

                               

Purpose of the role:

The Transportation Manager is an integral member of the Logistics Team and is responsible for directing the day-to-day execution of Pan India transportation function for SKF India (Industrial) Ltd.

This role will also have responsibility for ensuring the monthly financial performance is met and variances identified and addressed. This individual will also drive excellence in logistics delivery to minimize customer complaints to drive excellence in customer experience.

In addition, the selected individual will lead compliance to all existing processes, and alignment with Warehousing, Customer Service, Finance to ensure transportation needs & financial reporting are met and improved on.

Lead continuous improvement activities using SKF Production Systems tools and techniques to achieve benchmark level of operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Managing the daily operations of transportation, including coordinating routes, scheduling vehicles, and ensuring timely deliveries.
Monitoring and controlling transportation expenses, identifying cost-saving opportunities, driving projects to deliver spend reduction and optimizing the use of resources.
Staying updated on transportation regulations, obtaining necessary permits, and maintaining records to ensure compliance with government regulations.
Responsible for quality of deliveries to customers, ensure timely root cause analysis & implementation of corrective / preventive actions for delivery related customer complaints.
Drive Scope 3 emission reduction in logistics delivery through load optimization, alternative energy implementation in transportation etc. to enable meet SKF sustainability targets
Participate in procurement strategies for all Transportation categories.
Monitor and control the performance of external Carriers and the impact to cost using Contractual Relationships.
Drive the necessary improvements that impact the productivity of transportation spending categories.
Handle the customer Return process (RET) effectively to ensure timely return of materials from customers & closing them within stipulated timeline in system
Monitor transport compliance using Transportation Management system (TMS) to ensure goods are delivered & revenue is recognized in a timely manner, transporter bills are cleared without any pendency to ensure optimal working capital management

Key Performance areas:

Lead time compliance for deliveries to customers, logistics spend & cost savings, customer complaints from logistics (DER), Scope 3 emissions, compliance to financial indicators like timely provisioning, transporter bill clearance, customer return (RET) process

Profile Requirements

A bachelor's degree in logistics, engineering, business management, or a related area.
A solid understanding of the logistics and transportation industry.
Experience in problem solving skills & handling transportation related customer complaints
Skills for critical thinking and understanding of analytics.
Experience working using transport systems (TMS) as well as software for warehouse management
Ability to work under pressure & collaborate well with colleagues and manage difficult situations.
Strong analytical, problem solving and persuasive skills
Ability to prioritize, multitask and act in a proactive manner

 

Interested candidate/s can share their resume to hema.chaudhary@skf.com

title: Factory Controller
description:
Factory Controller

Location: Winsted, CT

Salary Range: $111,000.00 to $125,000.00

 

About SKF:  

SKF, reducing friction since 1907, re-imagining rotation for a better tomorrow! 

 

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer that has been a cornerstone in industrial life. Wherever there are machines or products in motion, SKF bearings are there to reduce friction. SKF drives the industries that support our way of life, powers the machines that put food on the table, and even helps explore the cosmos. 

 

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. SKF is on pace to decarbonize all its production facilities by 2030.  

 

We’re guided by our SKF values. Collaboration is critical to the success of our colleagues, partners, and customers. Curiosity and Courage provide a foundation for innovation and advancement. And we do this work out of Care for our people, customers, communities, and the planet.  

 

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.  

 

Learn about SKF at www.skf.com.  

 

Summary

SKF Aerospace is a first-tier supplier to the global aviation industry and much more. We design & manufacture complex, high performance, high-value bearings in steel and advanced ceramics. Our production group, technologies, & products are at the heart of aerospace industry.

 

The Aerospace Business Unit takes care of everything related to Aerospace applications. This includes Sales, Manufacturing, Business Development, and creating new products and processes.

 

Key Responsibilities

 In your role as Business Controller, directly reporting to the Cluster controller Aeroengine Europe and Balls Factories, you will be responsible mainly for the following activities:

 

Partner with Factory Management to provide timely financial analysis and key performance indicators (KPI’s) to maximize performance
Identify / initiate actions to improve profitability and assets turns, personally executing appropriate ones. Examples include working capital reduction strategies, contribution margin leakage and countermeasures, operations restructuring, product cost re-engineering, financial analysis and modeling, and sustaining lean manufacturing savings
Guide the annual organization of planning and budget allocation to promote the establishment of feasible goals aimed at consistent progress, accompanied by actionable steps to guarantee the realization of target results. Ensure a thorough understanding of plan drivers and opportunities / risks to facilitate development of cogent contingency plans
Facilitate the realization of specific results that either fulfill or excel beyond the planned benchmarks. Continuously monitor variances, identify risks and opportunities and initiate corrective actions
Ensure that internal controls and procedures are adequate (no significant deficiencies) and comply with the requirements of SKF Internal Control policy
Responsible for all Cost Accounting functions -- establishing standard cost, variance analysis, and month-end closing
Coordinate the end-to-end transformation process, which involves collecting data, performing analytics, and presenting findings, to guarantee profitability across the full value network
Investment controlling, including strategy alignment analysis, and tracking of business benefits
Factory Finance support for quoting new business, which may include preparation of cost estimates and analysis
Support to FOC and tax department when necessary (annual audit, tax controls…) and prepare Ad Hoc analysis and reports as required
Engaged team member with a significant footprint in the manufacturing floor

 

You will also be responsible for controlling of Sales Unit in Winsted, CT (USA).

  

We expect you to have

Experience in business controlling background with accounting experience in a manufacturing environment
Ability to analyze financial data and prepare concise financial reviews to make better business decisions
Sound analytical, problem identification and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to be proactive and innovative, and use critical and strategic thinking
Experience developing and using Standard Cost Accounting
Excellent MS Office skills and a solid understanding of ERP systems. Experience with financial consolidation systems such as XA and SARA Masterpiece would be a plus
Strong professional verbal communications and interpersonal skills
Preferred experience with data analytics and digital tools such as PowerBI
Ability to work within and facilitate a team environment

 

You’ll like working here if

You’re good at dealing with people, solving problems, and making decisions. You can handle and organize your work on your own. Also, if you are good at organizing your time and working with a team of people from different cultures.

 

We offer

A chance to grow professionally in a team that’s international and always changing. You’ll get to use your skills and abilities, and work with colleagues who want to make a difference for our customers and for the planet!

 

What You’ll Love About SKF: 

Rest and Relaxation. Enjoy a generous PTO policy and 13 paid holidays. 

 

Work/Life Integration. SKF supports work/life integration, home, family, community, personal well-being and health.   

 

Diversity in the Workplace.  At SKF, we strive to embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in everything we do. By developing a culture of belonging, our people can flourish; leading to an inclusive, equitable environment that promotes leadership, engagement and innovation.  

 

Best in Class Benefits. SKF cares about the wellbeing of our employees. Comprehensive healthcare options to fit your needs and opt out payment.  Added benefits include company paid life insurance, STD, LTD. Supplemental benefits include critical illness coverage, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs, and much more!  

 

Bonus. SKF offers STVS (Short Term Variable Salary) or Sales Incentive based on company performance and at the discretion of management.  

 

Invest in your Future. Participate in our 401K program that boasts a 10% employer contribution: 100% match up to 5% of your elected contribution (100% Vested) plus an additional 5% company contribution.

title: People Service Specialist
description:
About PX Operations

 

PX Operations is SKF’s global people experience engine — delivering precise, reliable, and human‑centered services that keep our organization moving. We ensure accurate pay, high‑quality data, efficient lifecycle services, and clear, timely support. As a globally connected team, we simplify processes, enhance experience, and help SKF create a better tomorrow for our people, our customers, and the industries we serve.

 

PX Operations — Precision in Service. Better Tomorrow in Motion. 

 

                                                                                                                                       Job Description

 

 

Role Title: People Service Specialist

Location: Pune, India



 

Purpose of the Role

 

The People Service Specialist is responsible for managing end-to-end HR operations with a strong focus on onboarding, offboarding, employee lifecycle processes, and HR digitization. The role ensures a seamless employee experience, data accuracy and completeness, compliance, and effective stakeholder coordination. 

 

 

Key Responsibilities – Onboarding and Employee Life Cycle management

 

Manage end-to-end New Hire Joining and Onboarding process
Handle pre-employment medical check-ups and documentation
Manage Background Verification (BGV) for all new hires
Conduct HR orientation sessions covering policies, systems and company overview
Oversee first two days of the induction plan
Process joining expenses, daycare and nanny allowance claims
Arrange factory visits for new hires at Pune and Bangalore locations
Manage end to end employee life cycle process including   transfers etc.
Responsible for maintaining complete and accurate salary master data and share inputs with payroll
Work hands-on with SuccessFactors HRMS for onboarding and employee life cycle activities
Manage employee queries with strong focus on employee experience
Work with cross functional teams for any process or systems enhancements.

 

Key Responsibilities – Offboarding

 

Manage end-to-end offboarding process for employees
Design, update, and manage exit clearance forms
Share exit process guidelines with employees
Issue relieving letters and exit-related documents
Maintain master exit tracker for data and recoveries
Capture actual reasons for exit for analysis
Share exit data with Compensation and Benefits team
Ensure timely termination of GADD and system IDs
Process Full and Final settlements accurately and on time in coordination with payroll team

 

Other Responsibilities

 

Create and maintain PAN India holiday calendar starting October
Publish Company Intranet announcements for new joiners and role changes
Support internal and external HR audits, HR Compliances
Issue internship and contract letters for consultants
Review and update employee policies on Spider Intranet platform
Act as SPOC for centralized HR data requirements
Drive Process improvements & HR digitization initiatives
Manage and enhance HR Chatbot adoption and effectiveness

 

Requirements / Qualifications

 

MBA in Human Resources Management
4–6 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Data and systems management or similar role
Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as SuccessFactors, Workday and Darwinbox
Strong understanding of HR policies and compliance
Excellent communication, problem-solving, customer and interpersonal skills
Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
Ability to work with minimal supervision
High attention to detail and data accuracy
Proven experience in onboarding, end to end employee life cycle and  offboarding processes

 

Benefits

 

Opportunity to work with most valued global brand
Competitive salary package
Health insurance and other employee benefits
Opportunities for professional development and growth
Collaborative and supportive work environment

 

 

Why join PX Operations?

 

You will be part of a team that powers the engine of SKF — ensuring every core people process runs smoothly so the organization can focus on innovation, performance, and growth. Here, you’ll help shape a better tomorrow while building a global career with purpose.

Análisis de datos y generación de oportunidades de negocio.

Gestión de proyectos de transformación digital.

Inglés avanzado.

description:
SKF Marine ist ein weltweit führender Hersteller schiffstechnischer Anlagen, z. B. von Stabilisatoren, Wellenkomponenten oder Ölaufbereitungssystemen (RecondOil). Weiterhin liefern wir Produkte um Meeresenergieanlagen wie z.B. Gezeitenkraftwerke. Unsere Lösungen ermöglichen zuverlässige, intelligente sowie saubere Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die einen reibungslosen Schiffsbetrieb gewährleisten.Für die SKF Marine GmbH an unserem Standort in Hamburg suchen wir schnellstmöglich einen

 

Masteranden (m/w/d) im Bereich Elektro- und Automatisierungstechnik

 

Deine Aufgaben

 

Erstellung einer Abschlussarbeit im Bereich Elektro- und Automatisierungstechnik von Flossenstabilisatoren

 

Das bringst du mit

 

Du bist in einem Masterstudiengang wie Schiffs- oder Maschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren eingeschrieben.
Erfahrung im Schiffs- oder Maschinenbau sind wünschenswert.
Du bringst sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office, SolidWorks sowie Kenntnisse in Matlab mit. Kenntnisse in Codesys und SAP ERP sind wünschenswert.
Vor Beginn der Abschlussarbeit ist ein dreimonatiges Praktikum bei der SKF Marine GmbH zu absolvieren.

 

Was bieten wir?

Wir bieten dir neben interessanten Einblicken in unsere Geschäftsprozesse viele spannende Aufgaben, die du zu einem guten Teil selbstständig meistern kannst. Als weltweit tätiges Unternehmen setzen wir auf Vielfalt und auf das Potenzial, das wir daraus schöpfen können – denn deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung liegt uns am Herzen. Ebenfalls bekommst du bei uns:

eine Attraktive Vergütung und flexible Arbeitszeiten,
eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und schnelle Integration,
Einblicke in ein internationales Unternehmen im Konzernverbund

 

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung unter Angabe des möglichen Starttermins und der gewünschten Wochenarbeitszeit. Bitte füge ein persönliches Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Immatrikulationsbescheinigung und evtl. auch Zeugnisse (Abschluss-/Arbeitszeugnisse) bei. Bitte beachte, dass wir nur PDF-Dateien akzeptieren.  Ohne den notwendigen Anlagen kann keine weitere Bearbeitung der Bewerbung stattfinden.

 

Wir begrüßen ausdrücklich die Bewerbungen von Schwerbehinderten und ihnen gleichgestellten behinderten Menschen!

 

Du hast Fragen?

title: Head of Cyber Security
description:
About SKF

 

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

 

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

 

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in

 

SKF Purpose Statement

 Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet 

 

 

JOB DESCRIPTION

 

 

Job Title:     Head Of Cyber Security

Reports To: Head of Global IT & OT Infrastructure, SIAM and Securities

Role Type:   People management

Location:      Pune and Bengaluru

 

Role Purpose:

 

The Head of Cyber Security will provide vision and strategic direction to enterprise-wide initiatives that ensure the security, reliability, and cyber-resiliency of IT Infrastructure, Platforms, Applications and Data. This role is critical in devising the cybersecurity strategy and roadmap in alignment with business requirements of all SKF Industrial Business Areas and Regions.

 

We are seeking an experienced Security Leader to strengthen our Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) posture across IT & OT Systems and conduct Risk Management for all Infra platforms, Applications, Data and devices.

This role will be accountable for maintaining compliance documentation standards, supporting certification and audit readiness for the organization, leading security control assessments, and driving consistent governance practices across technology and business environments.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Promote a strong cyber culture and promote Security and Compliance awareness across SKF Industrial organization.
Ensure that the company's IT systems hosting applications, data and Infrastructure Platforms are fully compliant with all applicable regulatory requirements and privacy laws.
Act as a key point of contact with Business and IT Leaders across the globe for cybersecurity-related communications and critical updates
Coach and develop cybersecurity analysts, acting as a mentor to the SKF and partner Cyber-Security organizations.
Oversee the implementation and maintenance of cybersecurity policies, frameworks, and controls.
Collaborate with BCIOs and Regional Security Teams to sensitize critical initiatives that will control security incidents, monitor threats, reduce vulnerabilities, and improve security incident response.
Ensure compliance with regulatory and industry standards (e.g., NIST, NIS 2.0, ITAR, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, GDPR).

 

Strategic Planning & Execution

 

Partner with functional leads to develop and execute strategic roadmaps for cybersecurity and infrastructure aligned with enterprise transformation goals.
Help SKF improve Continuous Delivery practices aligned with Cyber-Security roadmap.
Partner with architecture and procurement functions to ensure that Cyber Strategy and roadmap is in alignment with emerging Technology vision and roadmap.
Monitor KPIs and SLAs to ensure service excellence and continuous improvement.

 

Team Leadership & Development

 

Build and mentor a high-performing team of Cyber professionals providing coverage across all IT functions.
Advocate the IT and Business functions within SKF to uplift Platform Engineering capabilities in alignment with Cyber Security standards.
Foster a culture of innovation, automation, accountability, and collaboration.
Craft the cyber-vision in a manner that promotes AI-related initiatives across business functions and regions boosting digital transformation efforts.

 

The Essentials

 

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, management information systems, or related
Experience supporting modern software architectures in both development and production environments.
Experience implementing cybersecurity capabilities including GRC, Network Security, EDR, WAF, SIEM/SOAR, TLS, PKI, BC/DR, and Risk Management.
Experience in Identity and Access Management systems including IGA, PAM, SSO, MFA, and AD with important standards (i.e. OAuth, OpenIDC, SAML, SCIM, FIDO, etc.)
Experience or familiarity with key frameworks and certifications including NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, SOC2, ISO 27001, and IEC 62443
Proven experience managing large-scale IT operations and security programs.
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), enterprise networking, and security technologies.
Excellent soft skills , stakeholder management, and strategic acumen.
Thought leadership, development, and coaching experience and capabilities including functional and team goals & objectives, conflict resolution, and performance management.
Partner with multiple stakeholders and influence project decisions.

 

IT Focused Qualifications:

 

European Union: Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, EU Machinery Regulation (MR 2023/1230), RED Directive 2014/53/EU
United States: CIRCIA (2022), NIST CSF 2.0, TSA Pipeline Security Directives
China: Cybersecurity Law (2017), Data Security Law (2021), CII Regulations
Australia: SOCI Act (2021 + 2023 Amendments)
APAC & Global: Malaysia CRA Bill, India Digital Security Bill DPDPA.

 

OT Focus Qualifications:



EU: Connected products, machinery with embedded software, industrial networks
US: Critical infrastructure resilience & incident reporting
China: Data sovereignty & industrial control systems
Australia: Critical Infrastructure and Incident Response Obligations
APAC & Global: Localization of EU-style compliance requirements
Primary Skills:
Deep expertise in cybersecurity strategy, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
Strong leadership and decision-making abilities to align security initiatives with business goals.
Prepare Cyber Roadmap, Cyber Insure, Cyber Investment and RoI.
Secondary Skills:
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Knowledge of emerging technologies, threat intelligence, and incident response best practices.

 

Candidate Profile:

 

18+ years of experience in IT Security, Cyber Risk, or GRC roles.
Hands-on experience with IT and Cloud Risk Management programs.
Strong understanding of security controls, risk management principles, and cloud security (AWS, Azure).
Professional Certifications in CISSP, CISM, CRISC, PMP.
Experience building strategic technology plans and roadmaps
Excellent understanding of business complexity and project interdependencies and the ability to question thought partners across functional areas
Familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIS 2.0, ITAR and related security frameworks.
Excellent analytical, documentation, CxO Communication & presentation skills.

title: Comptable Fournisseurs
description:
Vous souhaitez rejoindre un environnement industriel exigeant, au cœur d’un groupe international, et contribuer à la fiabilité des processus financiers ?
SKF Aerospace France recrute

un(e) Comptable Fournisseurs (H/F) en CDI

pour renforcer son équipe Finance, localisée sur le site de Lons le Saunier (39)

 

Votre mission

Rattaché(e) au service Finance, vous assurez la saisie et le contrôle des factures fournisseurs, en garantissant la fiabilité des comptes et des flux liés au processus « Procure-to-Pay ».

Vous participez aux clôtures comptables mensuelles et annuelles.

Vous contribuez également à l’amélioration continue des processus et participez à divers projets financiers du groupe (upgrade SAP, e-invoicing…).

 

Vos responsabilités principales

1. Gestion des factures fournisseurs

Vous réceptionnez, enregistrez les factures, en lien avec les documents d’achat. Vous pouvez d’ailleurs avoir à bloquer une facture après analyse, le cas échéant, vous initiez les actions correctives avec les parties prenantes. Vous assurez le contrôle des factures bloquées, suivez les retards de paiement et faites les demandes d’avoirs.
Vous vérifiez la conformité des flux et analysez les écarts.

2. Justification des comptes fournisseurs

Vous analysez mensuellement les comptes fournisseurs et justifiez les postes en lien avec les services internes.

3. Interfaçage avec le Finance Operation Center de Poznan (Pologne)

Vous pouvez être amené(e) à travailler en lien avec les collègues du FOC (comptabilité générale et comptabilité fournisseurs)

4. Participation aux dossiers financés

Vous collectez et fournissez les données comptables nécessaires aux dossiers CIR et autres projets financés.

5. Amélioration continue & projets Finance

Apporter votre expertise comptable et système d’information dans les projets liés aux activités financières.

6. Reporting

 

Votre profil

Compétences techniques

Comptabilité générale et analytique
Pack Office, SAP
Connaissance des processus P2P et d’un environnement industriel
Anglais technique et professionnel écrit et oral (notamment dans le cadre des échanges réguliers avec le FOC)

Savoir-faire

Saisie et contrôle des factures
Analyse, collecte et synthèse de données comptables et financières
Capacité à apporter un avis expert

Qualités personnelles

Rigueur – Fiabilité – Autonomie – Sens des responsabilités – Réactivité – Proactivité – Esprit d’équipe

Formation et expérience

Bac+2 type BTS Comptabilité ou équivalent
Expérience significative sur un poste similaire en industrie

 

Envoyez-nous votre candidature (CV + lettre de motivation) et venez contribuer à la performance financière d’un acteur majeur de l’industrie aéronautique !

title: Head of Operations Transformation (F/H)
description:
Vous souhaitez jouer un rôle déterminant dans la transformation d'une entreprise technologique mondiale en pleine accélération ?
Vous êtes passionné(e) par les défis industriels complexes, la montée en maturité opérationnelle et la conduite de transformations à fort impact dans des environnements internationaux ?
Alors cette opportunité est faite pour vous !


Head of Operations Transformation- BU Magnetic Systems  (F/H)


Leader mondial des technologies de paliers magnétiques actifs et de moteurs à grande vitesse, SKF Magnetic Mechatronics développe des solutions innovantes utilisées par les plus grands acteurs de l'énergie, du transport et stockage du gaz naturel, du traitement des eaux, des semi-conducteurs et des procédés industriels de demain.
Implantée à Vernon (Eure), notre société compte près de 300 collaborateurs et fait partie d'une organisation internationale de près de 900 personnes. Nos technologies sont exportées dans le monde entier et plus de 85 % de notre activité est réalisée à l'international.

La Magnetic Systems Unit (MSU) représente aujourd'hui une organisation mondiale d'environ 900 collaborateurs, intérimaires et prestataires, répartis sur plusieurs implantations stratégiques. Aux côtés du siège de Vernon, la Business Unit s'appuie sur des opérations en Allemagne et au Canada (Calgary), sur un site industriel en forte croissance à Tanger (Maroc) ainsi que sur plusieurs implantations commerciales internationales, notamment à Dubaï.
Historiquement reconnue pour son excellence en ingénierie et ses solutions à très forte valeur ajoutée, notre activité entre aujourd'hui dans une nouvelle phase de son développement. La croissance de nos applications industrielles ouvre des perspectives majeures et nécessite une évolution profonde de nos modes de fonctionnement afin d'accompagner durablement la montée en cadence, renforcer notre performance opérationnelle et soutenir notre ambition de croissance.

Discover us on YouTube :https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=if3ZDyamOXA
À propos de S2M :https://www.skf.com/group/products/magnetic-bearings-systems

À propos du poste
Rattaché(e) au Magnetic Systems Unit Director, vous êtes membre de l'équipe de direction de la Business Unit et portez la transformation opérationnelle globale de la MSU.
Votre périmètre couvre les opérations industrielles, la supply chain et l'excellence opérationnelle à l'échelle internationale, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes basées en France, en Allemagne, au Canada, au Maroc et au Moyen-Orient.
Vous accompagnerez notamment la structuration des opérations mondiales, l'accélération de la montée en puissance du site de Tanger, le renforcement des processus de planification et de supply chain, ainsi que le déploiement de standards communs permettant de soutenir la croissance future de l'activité.
Votre mission ne consiste pas uniquement à faire fonctionner les opérations actuelles mais à construire les opérations de demain.
Vous définissez et déployez la stratégie opérationnelle permettant d'accompagner la croissance de l'activité, tout en renforçant la performance industrielle, la fiabilité de la supply chain, la qualité de l'exécution et la capacité de montée en puissance de l'organisation.
À l'interface entre les opérations, l'ingénierie, la R&D, la qualité, la finance et les ventes, vous fédérez les équipes autour d'une ambition commune : transformer une organisation reconnue pour son excellence technologique en une référence d'excellence opérationnelle.

Principales missions
Conduire la transformation opérationnelle de l'entreprise
•    Définir et déployer la feuille de route de transformation des opérations en cohérence avec les ambitions stratégiques de la Business Unit.
•    Accompagner l'évolution d'une organisation historiquement orientée ingénierie vers un modèle plus robuste, scalable et prédictible.
•    Identifier les leviers majeurs de performance et piloter les programmes de transformation associés.
•    Développer une culture de performance, de responsabilisation et d'amélioration continue à tous les niveaux de l'organisation.

Renforcer la supply chain et les processus de planification
•    Structurer et améliorer les processus S&OP afin de sécuriser la croissance future.
•    Améliorer la qualité des prévisions, la planification de la charge et la visibilité opérationnelle.
•    Accroître la fiabilité et la performance de l'ensemble de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
•    Piloter les risques fournisseurs et mettre en place des stratégies adaptées à un environnement fortement spécialisé.

Développer l'excellence opérationnelle
•    Déployer les principes Lean Manufacturing et Operational Excellence adaptés à un environnement de produits complexes et de petites séries.
•    Améliorer durablement les performances en matière de qualité, coûts, délais et satisfaction client.
•    Renforcer les standards opérationnels et promouvoir le partage des meilleures pratiques entre les différents sites.
•    Mettre en place les indicateurs de pilotage permettant une prise de décision rapide et efficace.

Accélérer l'industrialisation et la montée en cadence
•    Accompagner le développement des activités industrielles et soutenir leur croissance.
•    Renforcer les processus d'industrialisation afin d'améliorer la répétabilité et la robustesse de l'exécution.
•    Optimiser les flux, les capacités et l'utilisation des ressources.
•    Soutenir les initiatives de standardisation lorsque celles-ci créent de la valeur pour les clients et pour l'entreprise.

Exploiter le potentiel du digital
•    Faire évoluer l'utilisation des systèmes ERP afin d'améliorer la qualité des données et la performance des processus.
•    Promouvoir l'utilisation des outils digitaux comme accélérateurs de performance.
•    Piloter les projets de transformation numérique des opérations.

Leadership et développement des équipes
•    Encadrer et développer les équipes opérationnelles sur plusieurs sites et dans plusieurs pays.
•    Développer les compétences et préparer l'organisation aux enjeux futurs.
•    Favoriser la collaboration entre les équipes Opérations, Supply Chain, Qualité, R&D, Ingénierie, Finance, RH et Business Development.
•    Agir comme un véritable leader du changement auprès de l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Vous en quelques mots…
Formation & expérience
•    Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur ou équivalent.
•    Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans la transformation opérationnelle d'organisations industrielles complexes.
•    Vous avez déjà accompagné avec succès la montée en maturité industrielle d'une entreprise historiquement orientée ingénierie, projets ou petites séries.
•    Vous avez démontré votre capacité à structurer des opérations pour accompagner de fortes ambitions de croissance.
•    Vous avez évolué dans des secteurs tels que les équipements électromécaniques complexes, les moteurs électriques, l'automatisation industrielle, la mécatronique, l'énergie, les machines spéciales, l'aéronautique ou d'autres environnements technologiques comparables.

•    Vous avez idéalement acquis votre expérience au sein d'organisations internationales ou de PME/ETI technologiques confrontées à des enjeux de croissance à l’ international, d'industrialisation et de transformation opérationnelle.
•    Vous avez démontré votre capacité à structurer des opérations dans des environnements caractérisés par une forte complexité produit, des séries limitées, une supply chain spécialisée et une forte proximité entre les équipes d'ingénierie et les opérations

Vos atouts techniques
•    Solide expertise en supply chain, S&OP et planification industrielle.
•    Expérience démontrée dans l'amélioration de la performance opérationnelle d'environnements industriels à forte complexité technique.
•    Maîtrise des enjeux d'industrialisation, de montée en cadence et de transformation des opérations.
•    Capacité à structurer et exploiter efficacement un ERP comme levier de performance.
•    Expérience des démarches Lean Manufacturing et Operational Excellence dans des contextes de faibles volumes et de forte variabilité.
•    Bonne compréhension des problématiques liées aux fournisseurs spécialisés et aux chaînes d'approvisionnement complexes.
•    Solide maîtrise des indicateurs de performance et du pilotage budgétaire.

Vos qualités personnelles
•    Vision stratégique et pragmatisme opérationnel.
•    Leadership fédérateur et capacité à embarquer les équipes dans le changement.
•    Excellentes capacités de communication et d'influence.
•    Esprit d'équipe et forte culture de la collaboration.
•    Capacité à créer des ponts entre les équipes d'ingénierie et les équipes opérationnelles.
•    Orientation résultats et amélioration continue.
•    Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
•    Résilience dans des environnements exigeants et en forte croissance.
•    Intégrité, exemplarité et sens des responsabilités.

Langues
•    Vous évoluez quotidiennement dans un environnement international : un Anglais courant à l'écrit comme à l'oral est indispensable.

Ce qui fera la différence ?
Votre capacité à transformer une organisation industrielle de haute technologie, historiquement portée par l'excellence de son ingénierie, en une entreprise capable d'accompagner une forte croissance grâce à des opérations robustes, prédictibles et scalables, sans compromettre l'innovation, l'agilité ni la proximité avec les clients. 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
•    Prendre la tête d'une transformation stratégique majeure pour l'avenir de l'entreprise.
•    Avoir un impact direct sur la croissance et la compétitivité d'une activité mondiale.
•    Travailler sur des technologies contribuant à la transition énergétique et à la décarbonation de l'industrie.
•    Évoluer dans un environnement international réunissant des experts passionnés.
•    Rejoindre une entreprise où l'innovation technologique constitue un avantage concurrentiel reconnu à l'échelle mondiale.

Chez SKF, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement diversifié et inclusif où chaque collaborateur peut exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nous recrutons avant tout sur les compétences, l'expérience et la capacité à contribuer à notre réussite collective. Venez comme vous êtes, soyez vous-même. #weareSKF

Informations complémentaires
Ce poste est basé sur notre site de Vernon (27).
Des déplacements réguliers sur les différents sites internationaux de la Business Unit sont à prévoir.

Vous reporterez au Magnetic Systems Unit Director. 

Pour candidater
Vous êtes intéressé(e) par cette opportunité et vous souhaitez participer à la prochaine étape de transformation de SKF Magnetic Mechatronics ? N'hésitez pas à transmettre votre candidature au plus tard le 15 septembre 2026.

Chez SKF, nous nous engageons à promouvoir l'équité et l'inclusion tout au long de notre processus de recrutement. Pour atteindre cet objectif, nous pouvons inclure des évaluations et vérifier les informations fournies dans votre candidature, conformément aux lois et réglementations spécifiques à chaque pays.

title: Senior Account Manager - Affaires neuves Energie
description:
Vous souhaitez contribuer à des projets technologiques de pointe qui participent à la réduction de la consommation énergétique et à la décarbonation de l'industrie ?
Vous êtes passionné(e) par les environnements industriels complexes, les relations clients internationales et la gestion de projets à forte valeur ajoutée ?

Alors cette opportunité est faite pour vous !


Account Manager – Affaires neuves Energie (F/H)

Leader mondial des technologies de paliers magnétiques actifs et de moteurs à grande vitesse, SKF Magnetic Mechatronics développe des solutions innovantes utilisées par les plus grands acteurs de l'énergie, du transport et stockage du gaz naturel, du traitement des eaux, des semi-conducteurs et des procédés industriels de demain.
Implantée à Vernon (Eure), notre société compte près de 300 collaborateurs et investit massivement dans l'innovation avec plus de 10 % de son chiffre d'affaires consacré à la R&D. Nos technologies sont exportées dans le monde entier et plus de 85 % de notre activité est réalisée à l'international.

En rejoignant nos équipes, vous évoluerez au sein d'un environnement multiculturel unique réunissant plus de 20 nationalités et des experts reconnus en électronique de puissance, mécatronique, intelligence artificielle, automatisme, contrôle-commande, matériaux avancés et mécanique de précision.


Discover us on YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=if3ZDyamOXA
A propos de S2M : https://www.skf.com/group/products/magnetic-bearings-systems


A propos du poste 
Rattaché(e) au Responsable Ventes Energy, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le développement commercial de nos activités Energy.
Véritable chef d'orchestre de vos projets, vous accompagnez nos clients internationaux depuis l'identification du besoin jusqu'à la livraison finale des solutions SKF Magnetic Mechatronics.
À la croisée des enjeux commerciaux, techniques et industriels, vous pilotez des affaires stratégiques à forte valeur ajoutée et coordonnez les différentes expertises internes pour garantir leur succès.

Principales missions  
En véritable chef d’orchestre de vos affaires, vous accompagnez nos clients internationaux depuis l'identification de leurs besoins jusqu'à la livraison des solutions, en garantissant la satisfaction client, la rentabilité des projets et l'atteinte des objectifs fixés.

À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à :
•    Développer et gérer un portefeuille d'affaires dans le domaine des paliers magnétiques actifs, systèmes de contrôle-commande et équipements électroniques destinés aux turbomachines du secteur de l'énergie.

title: Key Account Manager - Industrial
description:
About SKF

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

 

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in

 

About Industrial Markets

The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate a commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs.

At SKF, we provide industry-leading engineering solutions and technologies to industrial market that consistently deliver reliability and efficiency in their day-to-day operations. We cater to a range of industrial sectors, including heavy industries, wind, metals, railways, and general machinery, and help customers achieve their key objectives, depending on their specific application needs and challenges around the machines and equipment.

 

SKF Purpose Statement

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 

JOB DESCRIPTION

 

Position Title:        Key Accounts Managers

Reports To:           Sales Manager

Role Type:              Individual Contribution

Location:                Pan India

 

Job Responsibilities

Build Key Account strategy (including forecast/plans) aligned to SKF’s strategy to achieve growth and profitability targets

Drive SKF key account management process/tools to achieve annual growth & margin targets

Acquire holistic understanding of key customers’ needs and map customer organization at all levels to get desired insights.

Identify right opportunities with the customer account to develop and deliver value-based offers for a win-win outcome.

Achieve revenue and profitability targets through OEMs and the distribution network in defined region / segment.

Ensure seamless connect between consultants, actual user and original equipment manufacturers.

 

Skill Set

Business Acumen and Financial knowledge

Territory Management

Domain Knowledge ( Product / Segment )

Stakeholder Management

Interpersonal Relationships

 

KPIs

Revenue & Margin Achievements

Hit ratio achieved YOY

Adoption (conversion of manual to automatic lubrication) rate enhancement.

Account Receivables

 

Education & Experience

Bachelor of Engineering (Preferred Mechanical)

5-8 years of sales & Key account manager experience in Industrial Sales

Preferred industry: Railways / General Machinery / Wind / Heavy Industries / Metals  

Ability to work independently or as an active member of a team

 

Interested candidates can share their resume to margaret.hirekerur@skf.com

title: Application Engineer
description:
Application Engineer

Location: Blue Bell, PA

Salary Range: 85,000.00 to 105,000.00

 

About SKF:  

SKF, reducing friction since 1907, re-imagining rotation for a better tomorrow! 

 

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer that has been a cornerstone in industrial life. Wherever there are machines or products in motion, SKF bearings are there to reduce friction. SKF drives the industries that support our way of life, powers the machines that put food on the table, and even helps explore the cosmos. 

 

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. SKF is on pace to decarbonize all its production facilities by 2030.  

 

We’re guided by our SKF values. Collaboration is critical to the success of our colleagues, partners, and customers. Curiosity and Courage provide a foundation for innovation and advancement. And we do this work out of Care for our people, customers, communities, and the planet.  

 

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.  

 

Learn about SKF at www.skf.com.  

 

Position Summary

The End-User Industries Application Engineer will grow SKF business as the technical thought leader in strategically identified market segments, while providing comprehensive Engineering support.  The Application Engineer is responsible for defining the technical needs of our end-users and translating them into an SKF offering.  They promote the SKF know-how and value proposition in line with corporate and industry segment strategy, working closely with Sales and Customer Service as part of the responsible Account Team.  They manage technical relationships with customers, responding to inquiries, handling complaints and evaluating technical risks.

 

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical support for all product platforms to customers as well as field sales and customer service.
Support existing activities, develop new technical solutions, maintain/establish technical contacts, provide technical insights, and generate opportunities within an assigned account base.
Proactively drive the technical agenda with end-user customers to establish brand preference for SKF.
Identify and manage technically oriented projects including high value platform integration solutions.
Be the technical specialist/resource within the Industrial Sales Unit for SKF products and technologies, through relationships with global subject experts.
Define the end-user technical voice and drive it throughout the entire SKF full value chain.
Provide product training and technical support to internal and external customers.
Technical support will include application review, bearing system selection and verification, installation, maintenance, troubleshooting and damage analysis.
Customer interaction will include on-site customer visits in addition to phone and email communications.
Resolve or mitigate impact of customer rotating equipment bad actors through making solution recommendations of both the surrounding system and bearing components.

 

Qualifications

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (or comparable degree)
Experience:
5+ years application experience in an industrial environment, calling on customers, preferably in focused industries (Pulp and Paper, Metals, Mining, Mineral Processing, Cement, or Food and Beverage)
Bearing or rotating equipment focus
Technical Skills:
Strong hands-on mechanical aptitude and manufacturing process knowledge
Proven track record of proactive and continuous improvement
Demonstrated ability to think strategically with demonstrated drive and passion
Excellent spoken and written communication skills
Demonstrated customer service, interpersonal, and teamwork skills
Outcome oriented, critical thinker capable of prioritizing to achieve results
Motivated self-starter with careful attention to detail

Travel Requirements

Travel approximately 30% of the time as customer need dictates

 

What You’ll Love About SKF: 

Rest and Relaxation. Enjoy a generous PTO policy and 13 paid holidays. 

 

Work/Life Integration. SKF supports work/life integration, home, family, community, personal well-being and health.   

 

Diversity in the Workplace.  At SKF, we strive to embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in everything we do. By developing a culture of belonging, our people can flourish; leading to an inclusive, equitable environment that promotes leadership, engagement and innovation.  

 

Best in Class Benefits. SKF cares about the wellbeing of our employees. Comprehensive healthcare options to fit your needs and opt out payment.  Added benefits include company paid life insurance, STD, LTD. Supplemental benefits include critical illness coverage, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs, and much more!  

 

Bonus. SKF offers STVS (Short Term Variable Salary) or Sales Incentive based on company performance and at the discretion of management.  

 

Invest in your Future. Participate in our 401K program that boasts a 10% employer contribution: 100% match up to 5% of your elected contribution (100% Vested) plus an additional 5% company contribution.

title: Account Manager - Aftermarket & Regional Sales and Services
description:
The Lubrication Lifetime Solutions Business Unit is responsible for the development, design and manufacturing of lubrication-related systems, tools and equipment. The Business Unit operates in a large number of countries and markets, with a customer portfolio that includes many major OE manufacturers of automotive and industrial products, as well as distribution channel partners. 

Are you ready to turn tough industrial challenges into high value global lubrication solutions? Do you thrive where product strategy, customer insight, and engineering meet? Are you passionate about building long-term customer partnerships and driving growth?


Then you could be our next 

 

Account Manager - Aftermarket & Regional Sales and Services

 

We are looking for an Account Manager to drive the performance development and lifecycle management of our Lubrication Lifetime Solutions portfolio. The focus will be on Sales in DACH Region where you will have sales and profit responsibility for specified customers and industries. In this role, you will act as the owner of the product and solution portfolio, translating customer challenges and needs into scalable, high-value offerings. You will work at the intersection of engineering, application engineering and factories to create differentiation, growth, and customer value.

 

Key Responsibilities

Grow the development of your customer accounts across the EMEA region, identifying new opportunities and expanding existing customer partnerships.
Negotiate prices and future contracts - pricing, payment & delivery terms, customer commitments - in line with valid guidelines, and ensure implementation of prices and associated discounts.
Continuously improve sales processes, tools, and ways of working to ensure a customer-focused approach based on the SKF Sales Excellence principles.
Ensure strong relationships with customers by e.g. regular customer visits (physical and remote), and by analyzing, negotiating and following up on call for tenders.
Monitor portfolio performance and continuously optimize solutions based on feedback and data, by representing the product and solutions portfolio internally and externally, including at customer meetings and industry events.

 

What you bring

To be ready for this role, you need to have:

An university degree in Mechanical or Business Engineering, or equivalent knowledge gained through relevant working experience.
Good understanding of lubrication systems and solution selling, with experience in sales for the industrial sector.
Ability to deliver profitable growth through long-term customer relationships, with experience in working with engineered-to-order or solution-driven portfolios.
Proficiency in IT tools, in particular SAP, Microsoft 365, and Salesforce.
Ability to translate technical complexity into clear customer value propositions, with proficient negotiations and communications skills.
Fluency in English and German, and high willingness to travel.

 

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself. #weareSKF

 

You Will Enjoy This Role if

You enjoy working on high impact applications where lubrication makes a significant difference to customer uptime, safety, and sustainability
You want a role that combines strategy and execution and have desire to improve solutions and build long-term customer value.

 

What you’ll love about SKF…

A culture of diversity and inclusion! 

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself #weareSKF 

A fair and transparent compensation!   

We provide transparent salary information in line with local legislations to eligible candidates and base our decisions on objective and gender-neutral criteria, such as professional experience, technical skills, to ensure fairness and consistency throughout the recruitment process.  

  

Additional information
The sales territory primarily covers parts of Southern and Western Germany. Therefore, the preferred location for this position is the Greater Frankfurt area (Homeoffice).

You will report to the Manager Sales DACH, who is located in Walldorf, Germany.

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Katrin Edelmann, Talent Acquisition Partner Europe & Africa, by email katrin.edelmann@skf.com. Please note that we can't accept applications via email, due to GDPR. 

 

Is this you? 
If the answer is yes, submit your application with your CV and cover letter latest September-18-2026. Please note that we can't accept applications via email, due to GDPR. 

 

To support a transparent process, we may include assessments and before hiring we can verify the information in your application in compliance with country-specific laws and regulations.

Purpose of the role

 

A Finance Controlling role responsible for leading Controlling and Reporting activities to support financial planning, analysis, and decision-making for LLS India. This position serves as a bridge between finance and operations, ensuring that cost optimization initiatives are aligned with business objectives and drive operational efficiency.


Profile of the job holder/key requirements

CA / CA- Inter / ICWA / CMA with 4 to 8 years of post-qualification experience.
Hands-on experience in Financial Planning and Global reporting
Strong working experience on MS Office and good understanding of SAP ERP - FICO,
Sound knowledge in Power BI.
Good communication skills, verbal and written
Strong collaboration with stakeholders across Cross Functional Teams
Ability to independently handle / manage day-to-day tasks

 

Key Responsibilities

An individual contributor role to manage day-to-day Controlling and Reporting Responsibilities of all Manufacturing activities in line with India and Corporate (SKF Group) requirements.

Controlling Responsibilities

Partner with Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Logistic and Operations teams to provide financial insights and recommendations.
Operating profit analysis for Manufacturing unit which includes material cost variance analysis, plus Fixed and variable cost analysis.
Primarily responsible for updating standard costs annually in the PC Tool; analyzing the deviations of standard costs, ensure proper evaluation, and timely reporting.
Assess proposed capital investments by analyzing financial viability, ROI, payback period, and alignment with Business plan. Track expenditure against approved IRE.
Monitor inventory to identify opportunities for optimization. Analyse slow-moving and obsolete inventories, discards / write-offs; monitor and analyse inventory count results.
Provide clear insights into various cost drivers and continuously monitor to ensure overall cost is minimized.
Strong expertise in SAP-ERP (FICO) Product Costing functionalities, including Cost Component Structure, Routing, Costing Variant configuration, Parallel Valuation, and Settlement Structure.
Carry out cost-level analysis for the manufacturing unit to deliver a comprehensive overview of operations, including tracking actual cost developments at the operational level on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.
Actual vs Forecast Analysis showing comparison on month/quarter vs Forecast
Ensure compliance with SKF financial policies, internal controls and audit plan for the year
Controlling Governance - Respond to queries from Group and other stakeholders and provide timely and accurate information
Cost Project Validation & Controls - Streamline activities and work on improvement projects in line with required KPIs

 

Accounting And Reporting Responsibilities

Costing Power BI Ownership - Support the LLS. Business teams including Factory, in all necessary activities and provide costing related data as required from time to time.
Financial Reporting - Lead the month-end activities related to financial reviews, accruals and data submission to Finance Accounting teams.

Job Summary: 

Operators are held responsible for the quality and quantity of their work. Perform all production activities including but not limited to: setting machines, making machine adjustments to yield good parts to specified dimensions, setting and measuring on all gages in accordance with prescribed methods, presenting parts to inspection areas that may be outside of the department, trouble shooting and correcting operating conditions, handling material without damage to product, the visual inspection of production parts and tooling, counting parts, changing tools/wheels/diamonds, completing documentation (such as routers, and discrepancy reports), and communicating with all personnel. title: Payroll Team Leader
description:
Aller vite, penser vite, c’est être au cœur du mouvement… SKF l’a compris et chaque jour dans le monde, nos collaborateurs partagent cet engagement. Dans le cadre du développement de son Centre de Services Partagés Paie, SKF recherche un(e) Coordinateur / Team Leader Paie pour accompagner la transformation de ses activités Paie et Gestion des Temps au sein d'un environnement international en pleine évolution.

Coordinateur / Team Leader Paie (F/H)

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) au Responsable Paie France, vous évoluez au sein d'une organisation composée de deux Team Leaders Paie couvrant l'ensemble des activités du Centre de Services Partagés Paie.
Le CSP assure la gestion d'environ 2 500 salariés, répartis sur 4 entités juridiques et 6 sites en France. Dans ce cadre, vous prenez en charge un périmètre d'environ 1 500 salariés et animez fonctionnellement une équipe de 3 à 4 gestionnaires de paie.

Vous êtes garant(e) de la qualité, de la conformité et de la performance des activités Paie et Gestion des Temps sur votre périmètre. Vous accompagnez également la transformation de l'organisation à travers le développement des services partagés, la digitalisation des processus et le transfert progressif de certaines activités de Gestion des Temps vers la Pologne.

Principales responsabilités
Piloter les activités Paie et Administration du Personnel
•    Garantir la production fiable et dans les délais de la paie et des déclarations sociales.
•    Coordonner les activités de paie sur votre périmètre d'environ 1 500 salariés.
•    Assurer le contrôle des éléments variables de paie, des soldes de tout compte et des déclarations sociales.
•    Garantir la conformité des pratiques avec la législation sociale, les conventions collectives et les accords d'entreprise.

Animer et développer votre équipe
•    Animer, accompagner et développer une équipe de 3 à 4 gestionnaires de paie à travers des points de suivi bi-hebdomadaires
•    Définir les priorités opérationnelles et suivre l'avancement des activités, organiser la répartition de la charge de travail et assurer la continuité de service.
•    Accompagner la montée en compétences des collaborateurs par la formation, le coaching et le partage des bonnes pratiques.
•    Favoriser la coopération, l'engagement de l'équipe et la recherche de solutions d'amélioration continue.
•    Assurer la coordination avec le second Team Leader Paie afin de garantir une harmonisation des pratiques sur l'ensemble du CSP.

Superviser les activités de Gestion des Temps en Pologne
•    Assurer la supervision fonctionnelle des équipes en charge de la Gestion des Temps basées en Pologne.
•    Accompagner le transfert progressif des activités de Gestion des Temps vers le Hub régional.
•    Définir et déployer les procédures, modes opératoires et standards nécessaires à la réussite du transfert.
•    Mettre en place des indicateurs et outils de suivi permettant de mesurer la qualité du service et la fiabilité des données.
•    Veiller au respect des engagements de qualité et des délais de traitement.

Contribuer à la transformation des processus
•    Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration des processus Paie et Gestion des Temps.
•    Simplifier, fiabiliser et standardiser les modes de fonctionnement.
•    Participer aux projets de transformation RH et au déploiement du nouveau modèle de services.
•    Développer des outils de pilotage permettant d'améliorer la qualité de service et la performance opérationnelle.

Piloter les outils et la relation fournisseurs
•    Assurer la relation opérationnelle avec les prestataires de Gestion des Temps (Horoquartz) et de Paie (ADP Decidium).
•    Identifier les besoins d'amélioration des systèmes afin d'optimiser les processus et l'expérience utilisateur.
•    Coordonner les évolutions de paramétrage en réponse aux évolutions légales, conventionnelles et aux accords d'entreprise locaux.
•    Organiser les tests, valider les évolutions et assurer leur mise en production.

Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes
•    Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des équipes RH, Finance, Contrôle de Gestion Sociale et des managers sur les sujets Paie et Gestion des Temps.
•    Coordonner les travaux avec les équipes comptables dans le cadre des provisions, clôtures mensuelles et rapprochements comptables.
•    Produire et analyser les indicateurs nécessaires au pilotage des activités et à la prise de décision.
•    Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité de service apportée aux collaborateurs et aux managers.

Vous en quelques mots
•    Formation supérieure en Ressources Humaines, Gestion, Comptabilité ou Paie.
•    Expérience significative en gestion de la paie avec une expérience réussie de coordination ou de management d'équipe dans un contexte de centre de services partagés paie.
•    Solide maîtrise de la législation sociale française et des processus de paie.
•    Bonne connaissance des activités de Gestion des Temps.
•    Expérience des outils ADP Decidium et/ou Horoquartz appréciée.
•    Capacité à conduire des projets et à accompagner des transformations organisationnelles.
•    Sens du service, rigueur, esprit d'analyse et orientation résultats.
•    Excellentes qualités relationnelles permettant d'interagir avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales.
•    Anglais professionnel souhaité.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Vous intégrerez une fonction clé au cœur de la transformation des services RH de SKF.
Ce poste vous permettra de combiner management d'équipe, expertise paie, pilotage d'activités délocalisées, amélioration continue et participation active à la mise en œuvre du nouveau modèle de services RH dans un environnement international stimulant.
Chez SKF, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement diversifié et inclusif où chacun peut développer son potentiel et contribuer à notre réussite collective. #weareSKF

Ce poste est basé sur notre site de Saint-Cyr-sur-Loire (37).

Position Title:   SME – Hard Machining Expert (Grinding and Honing and Hard Turning)

Reports To:       General Manager Manufacturing Engineering and Quality

Role Type:         Individual Contributor

Location:           Ahmedabad Manufacturing Plant

 

 

Purpose of the Role:

To drive process improvements, support new product development, and ensure smooth execution of grinding and honing operations during the factory expansion. The role involves commissioning new machines, optimizing cycle times, and implementing advanced manufacturing techniques to enhance productivity and quality.

 

Responsibilities:

Serve as the technical expert for grinding and honing operations during the factory expansion phase.
Lead the installation, commissioning, and validation of new grinding and honing machines and channels.
Define and optimize process parameters to meet quality, productivity, and cost targets.
Conduct process trials, capability studies, and establish standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Troubleshoot process issues and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including design, quality, maintenance, and production to ensure seamless integration of new equipment.
Train engineers and operators on new processes, machines, and best practices.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process capability and reduce waste.
Support CAPEX planning and vendor evaluation for grinding and honing equipment.
Drive cycle time reduction initiatives in grinding and honing processes.
Support new product development by designing and validating processes that meet SKF specifications.
Introduce new abrasives and tools to improve output and reduce costs.
Participate in PFMEA, Control Plan, and other documentation for new and existing products.
Lead technology improvement projects including vision systems and automation.
Manage machine qualification activities using FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) and SAT (Site Acceptance Test) methodologies.
Implement Engineering Change Requests (ECR) and ensure effective change management.
Release and maintain process documentation including Process Flow Diagrams, Setup Charts, Process Validation Reports, and Process Drawings.

 

Metrics:

Cycle time improvement and resolution of process deviations.
Number of new products successfully developed and launched.
Productivity and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) improvements.
Timely installation and qualification of new machines and equipment.

 

Competencies:

Technical:

Process Knowledge: Tooling design for new products, setup chart preparation, POI development, troubleshooting waviness and lobe issues, and process improvement for quality, cost, and cycle time.
Technology Focus: Application of Grinding Cycle Monitor Equipment (GCM) in process, SMED methodology, and innovation in grinding and honing.
Statistical Knowledge: Proficient in statistical process control tools and understanding of PPM.
Project Management: Experience in managing machine qualification (FAT/SAT), ECR implementation, and documentation for new product development.
Structured Problem Solving: Skilled in 5 Why, A3 methodology, and Six Sigma Green Belt certified.
Industry 4.0: Exposure to I4.0 applications, digitization, and advanced manufacturing techniques.
SPS (SKF Production System): Application of lean manufacturing and resetting excellence principles.

Behavioral:

Patience: Demonstrates composure and persistence in complex problem-solving environments.
Curiosity: Actively seeks knowledge and explores innovative solutions.
Collaboration: Works effectively with cross-functional teams and supports knowledge sharing.
Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively across levels.
Accountability: Takes ownership of tasks and delivers results with integrity.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and lead cross-functional initiatives.
Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset.

 

Candidate Profile:

Education: B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering.
Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of relevant experience in manufacturing engineering, in grinding and honing operations.
Location: Ahmedabad manufacturing plant; active involvement in factory expansion projects is essential.

 

If interested, please share your updated profile @ supriya.joshi@skf.com

title: Scientist Lubrication - (NL-SE-DE)
description:
Do you thrive working with a combination of Research & Technology development and collaborating with people with different competencies? Are you excited about research and innovation? If yes, then please continue reading.

We are the Research & Technology Development (RTD) team at SKF B.V. Netherlands. We are a diverse and multicultural group of creative and innovative professionals primarily based in Houten, the Netherlands. We create value by providing innovative solutions around Research and Technology for bearings. To strengthen the Lubrication Team in Houten we are looking for a:

 

                                                            Scientist Lubrication - (Leadership role) - (Houten (NL), Gothenburg (SE) or Schweinfurt (DE)

 

This position is a senior role in the team of professional lubrication specialists. As a Scientist, you collaborate and lead Research and Technology development activities to develop, scale up, and transfer the knowledge between RTD and SKF operations. You combine a solid scientific background with a hands-on approach to develop physics-based models to contribute to the area of lubricating grease and bearing performance and life predictability. You will be leading and supporting R&D projects focused on lubrication, Grease Life (Theory) modeling, lubricant, and material selection.

 

Job Requirements

A PhD in mechanical engineering or physics/chemical engineering.
After your PhD, you gained 10+ years of relevant experience in bearing lubrication and modeling.
A broad and advanced knowledge specifically on grease lubrication and various modeling techniques
Proven stakeholder management and leadership in identifying the research and technology needs in the area of lubrication and bringing the experts together to solve a technical challenge in the application
Experience in lubricant selection for bearings, specifications and tribology; high interests to guide & perform experimental research in support of modeling.
Proven ability to drive full value chain from customers technology needs to R&D and vice versa
Having a helicopter view on lubrication competence and ability to mentor and coach a group of various experts in the area of lubrication
Enthusiastic attitude; initiative-taking and pro-active personality; business-focused and result-oriented; advanced communication skills and fluent in English.

 

Key Responsibilities

Leading and supporting the Grease Life and Friction modeling, transferring the experimental research into models, and guiding experimental research.
Contribute and support in providing the inputs for Lubrication research roadmaps.
Guide and support the collaboration with external partners (Universities and Suppliers).
Steer the technical discussion with various stakeholders (customers, suppliers, manufacturers etc.) to contribute to mapping and completing the future needs of various SKF business segments.
Building insights, knowledge, and skills on different lubrication technologies.
Aiding in technical development and mentoring of junior specialists like researchers and senior researchers with PhDs.
Manage and contribute to the Research and Technology development activities around Lubrication. Nurture and support to innovation and knowledge development in the lubrication area.

 

Our offer

We offer you the opportunity to work in an innovative and well-equipped R&D international environment, which is part of a large, innovative company with a proven reputation. The position is based in the team in the Netherlands (Houten). You will join a team of highly motivated colleagues and you will work in cross-competence projects. We look forward to seeing you develop as a professional who creates a career in SKF, and we will support your steps. Of course, our employment conditions are competitive. SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we passionately believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued growth. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential.

 

Additional information

This position will be in Houten (NL), Gothenburg (SE) or Schweinfurt (DE), on a local contract. Preferred location is in Houten, the Netherlands. You will report to the Competence Area Team leader Lubrication. 

 

How to apply

If you are interested and meet the above requirements, please apply via our website or LinkedIn with your CV and motivation letter. We only take applications into consideration that are written in English.

Job Purpose:

The Logistics & Export Compliance Coordinator is responsible for overseeing all outbound and inbound logistics activities, ensuring full compliance with domestic and international export regulations, optimizing transportation methods, and managing logistics-related costs. This role exists to provide advanced oversight, planning, and problem resolution across the entire shipping lifecycle—from documentation and carrier selection to tracking, escalation management, and continuous improvement of logistics processes. The position ensures that all shipments meet regulatory, quality, and customer requirements while supporting the overall efficiency and

cost-effectiveness of the supply chain.

 

Key Job Functions:

 

Product Preparation s Pre-Shipment Packaging
Prepare outbound products for shipment, including palletization, shrink-wrapping, banding, and securing loads to meet carrier and customer requirements.
Select appropriate packaging materials (crates, pallets, cushioning, moisture protection, etc.) based on product type, fragility, weight, and destination.
Ensure packaging meets international shipping standards, including wood-packaging regulations (ISPM-15) and customer-specific requirements.
Inspect final packaged goods to verify stability, labeling accuracy, and compliance with QMS and export documentation.
Coordinate with Production and Quality to ensure products are released, staged, and prepared for timely pickup.
Maintain shipping related packaging material inventory and recommend replenishment or improvements to reduce cost and improve protection. (packaging, forms, pallets, labels equipment etc.).
Ensure proper ERP transactions for material movements, receipts, and shipments.
Maintain an organized and compliant warehouse and shipping area.

 

Advanced Shipping s Logistics Management
Coordinate all domestic and international shipments, including complex multi-leg and export-controlled shipments.
Select carriers and logistics partners based on cost, performance, and compliance requirements.
Prepare, review, and validate all shipping documentation (BOLs, commercial invoices, export declarations, certificates of origin, B13, AES filings, etc.).
Ensure adherence to export control regulations (ITAR/EAR), tariff classifications, and customs requirements.
Track shipments proactively, identify delays or risks, and implement corrective actions.
Serve as the primary point of contact for carriers, brokers, freight forwarders, and customs officials.
Maintain and improve logistics SOPs in alignment with QMS and EHCS policies.

 

Export Controls & Compliance Oversight
Ensure all shipments comply with CBSA, PIP, U.S. and international export regulations.
Maintain accurate tariff codes, ECCNs, and country-specific documentation requirements.
Conduct periodic audits of shipping documentation and export records.
Support internal and external compliance reviews and audits.
Train team members on export control requirements and documentation accuracy.

 

Cost Management s Logistics Optimization
Monitor freight costs, surcharges, and accessorial fees; identify cost-saving opportunities.
Analyze carrier performance and negotiate rates or service improvements.
Recommend packaging, routing, and consolidation strategies to reduce cost and improve efficiency.
Prepare monthly logistics cost reports and KPIs for management review.

 

Problem Resolution s Cross-Functional Coordination
Lead investigations into shipment delays, damages, customs hold, or documentation discrepancies.
Collaborate with Purchasing, Quality, Production, and Customer Service to resolve issues quickly.
