title: Associate - Material Failure Analyst
description:
About SKF

 

SKF is the world leading supplier of products and solutions in the bearing business including technical support, maintenance services, condition monitoring and training.

The inherent skills and competence of our around 40,000 employees help us to fulfill our objective of creating more intelligent, sustainable and innovative customer solutions. SKF is a truly global company with presence in more than 130 countries, serving an extensive range of industries and customers worldwide. SKF started its operations in India in 1923.

 

SKF has hands-on experience in over 40 industries with knowledge and a vast product portfolio across the SKF technology platforms: bearings and units, seals, lubrication systems, condition monitoring equipment, and services.

 

We operate in four regions – the Americas, Europe, Middle East & Africa, India & Southeast Asia and China & Northeast Asia – to serve customers with speed and responsiveness.

 

SKF has been in India since more than 100 years and has a pan India footprint consisting of 6 manufacturing facilities, 12 offices, a supplier network of over 300 distributors and an employee base of more than 2600 dedicated professionals.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in

 

Innovation is the key:

We make some of the world’s most innovative products and solutions to reduce friction. But we sell something bigger. Less friction means more energy saved. And it means that society can move forward to a more energy-efficient future where we can all do more with less.

 

Sustainability:

At SKF, we have a long history of working with industrial sustainability. It is an integral part of what we do every day. And we strive to create engagement throughout the business, not only by implementing sustainability on a strategic level, but also by encouraging the ideas and grass root projects initiated by our people around the world.

 

About Technology Development

The TD team for ISEA is focused on Customer Product development & Engineering, Innovation for the region, rollout of new technologies for the region, testing, Failure Investigation, scaleup from POC to series production, Portfolio Management etc.

  

TD Competencies

Engineering & Research Centre
Product Development & Engineering – This division brings out conceptual/detailed designs to support BOH/ETO activities based on customer specifications. Technology trends like digitization of workflows, e- Aviation, Sensorization, Product localization, Design automation, Agile, DFX and Model based designs, (MBDs) have increased the operational efficiency and application productivity. What our customer gain from this is efficient digital data exchange, traceability and flexibility in design changes, reduced carbon footprint and higher performance products.
Testing: Group Testing Services is a trusted partner in design, process and supplier validation. The testing team ensures greater focus on customer requirements, quality and operational efficiency. This entails greater support for SKF’s processes in a faster manner by applying global test standards, adapted to local customer specific requirements.
Global Metallurgy & Chemistry Laboratory (GMC)
Future Factory (Manufacturing 4.0) – Working on World class manufacturing – Lean, Green, Digital.
Manufacturing Process & Development - We support factories in the areas of process development (Heat treatment), machine building, Advanced Manufacturing – HT simulations, Additive Manufacturing, Vision Inspection etc. We are working on building innovative solutions on machines (measurement/ assembly/ clean manufacturing) and focusing on Scaling technologies like 3D printing and Camera based Inspection system with automation.
Connected Technologies- develop new products for connectivity and sustain it. We work on sensor technology and data integration. This help customer for predictive maintenance of their assets

 

   SKF Purpose Statement

    Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

    By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 

 

                                                                                                                                 JOB DESCRIPTION

Preparation of metallographic samples for metallography and performing basic metallographic inspection as per schedule.
Operation and basic maintenance of X Ray diffraction machine
Operation and basic maintenance of scanning electron microscope
Operating Rockwell, Vickers & Micro Vickers hardness tester and to check chemical composition of steel using Optical emission spectrometer, Carbon and Sulphur analyzer and Oxygen and nitrogen gas analysis.
Support SEM analysis and EDS analysis of particles.

Material handling and tracking.

Functional

Hands-on experience metallographic sample preparation, microstructure analysis and mechanical and chemical testing.

Hand on experience in operating SEM And XRD machine

Basic knowledge on failure analysis

Basic knowledge on lubricant properties and its influence on performance characteristics.

Stake holder management.

title: Senior IT lead - S&OP
description:
About SKF

 

SKF is the world leading supplier of products and solutions in the bearing business including technical support, maintenance services, condition monitoring and training.

The inherent skills and competence of our around 40,000 employees help us to fulfill our objective of creating more intelligent, sustainable and innovative customer solutions. SKF is a truly global company with presence in more than 130 countries, serving an extensive range of industries and customers worldwide. SKF started its operations in India in 1923.

 

SKF has hands-on experience in over 40 industries with knowledge and a vast product portfolio across the SKF technology platforms: bearings and units, seals, lubrication systems, condition monitoring equipment, and services.

 

We operate in four regions – the Americas, Europe, Middle East & Africa, India & Southeast Asia and China & Northeast Asia – to serve customers with speed and responsiveness.

 

SKF has been in India since more than 100 years and has a pan India footprint consisting of 6 manufacturing facilities, 12 offices, a supplier network of over 300 distributors and an employee base of more than 2600 dedicated professionals.

 

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in

 

 

SKF Purpose Statement

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 

 

JOB DESCRIPTION

 

  

Job title: Senior IT Lead S&OP

Reports To: Aerospace BU IT and Digitalization Manager

Role Type: Individual Contributor

Location: Bangalore

 

Position Overview

 

We are seeking a high-caliber Senior IT Lead for Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) who combines enterprise IT architecture capability with deep functional manufacturing expertise. S&OP in aerospace manufacturing is a high-stakes, data-intensive process. Without a dedicated technology leader who understands how shop-floor realities translate into data models, planning programs routinely stall, and the organization operates on disconnected spreadsheets rather than a single version of the truth.

In this role, you will be the single accountable owner for our S&OP technology ecosystem. Your immediate focus will be architecting and delivering internal, interim S&OP data and planning solution built on modern data infrastructure. Long-term, you will lead our enterprise migration to SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP). Critically, you will serve as a bridge between manufacturing operations and digital systems—translating complex production constraints like machine bottlenecking, multi-level Bills of Materials (BOMs), and long-horizon demand patterns into a seamless digital planning backbone.

This is a build-from-the-ground-up opportunity. You will shape how our business unit plans, and your work will directly influence executive decision-making at the monthly S&OP cycle.

 

 

Why This Role Exists

 

Our business unit is building its S&OP process from the ground up. We need a dedicated technology owner who can architect the data foundation, not bolt tools onto broken processes.
The broader Data & Analytics team is executing an advanced AI and analytics roadmap. Without a ring-fenced S&OP technology lead, reactive planning firefighting will consume bandwidth that must be protected for strategic initiatives.
Our eventual migration to SAP IBP requires that the interim solution be built with forward-compatible data schemas and master data governance—this demands intentional architecture from day one.
S&OP success in aerospace manufacturing depends on someone who can credibly speak both the language of the shop floor (routers, work centers, cycle times) and the language of enterprise data architecture (data models, integration patterns, MDM).

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

1. S&OP Data Architecture & Manufacturing Integration

 

Capacity & Bottleneck Modeling: Architect data flows that accurately capture shop-floor realities, including work center capacities, bottleneck operations, machine efficiencies, and demonstrated run rates vs. theoretical standards.
Production Data Integration: Ensure data models deeply integrate critical manufacturing primitives: complex multi-level Bills of Materials (BOMs), operational routers, step-by-step cycle times, lead times, and component availability logic.
Aerospace Demand Modeling: Build and tune demand-side data feeds to handle low-volume/high-mix complexities, long-horizon backlogs (often 12–36+ months), and strict customer compliance and traceability requirements.
Master Data Governance: Establish and enforce master data standards for items, work centers, BOMs, and routers to ensure data quality across the planning ecosystem.

 

2. Technical Strategy & Solution Delivery

 

End-to-End Ownership: Serve as the single point of accountability for S&OP systems delivery—ensuring data availability, reconciliation, and integration across demand, supply, finance, and operations.
Interim Solution Design: Design and deploy the internal interim S&OP solution using modern data architecture (e.g., Snowflake, Power BI, Streamlit, or equivalent). Ensure data schemas and governance are structurally aligned to accelerate future SAP IBP migration.
SAP IBP Roadmap Ownership: Own the technical roadmap for SAP IBP adoption, including requirements definition, vendor/SI partner interaction, data migration planning, and integration architecture with the core ERP backend.
System Integration: Oversee technical integration between core ERP systems (SAP S4/HANA, Infor M3, Infor XA etc, master data, inventory, open orders), advanced scheduling systems, and the S&OP planning layer.

 

3. Organizational Enablement & Change Management

 

Cross-Functional Translation: Facilitate technical alignment across Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, and Sales—ensuring all functions operate from a single, validated data set through each phase of the S&OP cycle.
Process-Technology Alignment: Work closely with the S&OP process owner to ensure technology design directly supports the 5-step S&OP cadence (Data Gathering, Demand Review, Supply Review, Pre-S&OP, Executive S&OP).
Training & Adoption: Develop training materials, user documentation, and hands-on enablement programs to drive adoption of new S&OP tools across planning, operations, and finance teams.
Bandwidth Protection: Serve as the primary technical triage point for S&OP system issues, ring-fencing the broader Data & Analytics team so they can remain focused on the core AI and advanced analytics roadmap.

4. Vendor & Partner Management

 

SI/Vendor Governance: Manage relationships with systems integration partners, software vendors, and consultants involved in S&OP solution delivery and future SAP IBP implementation.
Build vs. Buy Evaluation: Continuously evaluate build-vs-buy decisions for planning capabilities, balancing speed-to-value with long-term architectural sustainability.

 

Candidate’s Profile:

 

Experience: 8+ years in IT/Digitalization roles, with 3+ years explicitly focused on supply chain planning, S&OP, or Integrated Business Planning technology.
ERP & Planning Systems: Hands-on experience with SAP IBP modules (Demand, Supply & Response, or S&OP) or equivalent enterprise planning platforms. Experience integrating planning systems with foundational ERP backends (SAP S/4HANA, Infor M3, XA, or equivalent tier-1 manufacturing ERPs).
Data Foundations: Strong proficiency in SQL, data warehousing concepts, and master data management (MDM). Experience working with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) is a plus.
Visualization & Prototyping: Experience building reporting layers and planning dashboards using tools like Power BI, Streamlit, or equivalent.

 

Functional Manufacturing Expertise

 

Deep Shop-Floor Literacy: Strong working knowledge of manufacturing execution concepts—how a router functions, how work center bottlenecks impact rough-cut capacity planning (RCCP), how component availability impacts multi-level BOM explosion, and how scheduling interacts with finite capacity.
S&OP Frameworks: Thorough understanding of the S&OP process cycle and how data must step up through each phase—from granular transactional data to aggregated executive planning views.
Industry Context: Experience in industrial manufacturing. Familiarity with aerospace sector dynamics (demand volatility, long lead-time components, strict traceability and compliance requirements) is highly preferred.

 

Preferred (Differentiators)

 

Experience leading or participating in a full SAP IBP implementation lifecycle (not just configuration).
Experience with ITAR-regulated or defense manufacturing environments and associated data handling requirements.
Exposure to CMMC, AS9100, or equivalent aerospace quality/compliance frameworks from an IT systems perspective.
Familiarity with Infor M3, Infor XA, SAP S4/HANA ERP and its integration patterns.
Understanding of AI/ML applications in demand sensing, supply planning, or inventory optimization.
Experience with agile delivery methods for enterprise planning projects.

title: PLM Implementation Specialist
description:
PLM Implementation Specialist

Location: Blue Bell, PA

Salary Range: $ 111,000.00 to $ 125,000.00

 

About SKF:

SKF, reducing friction since 1907, re-imagining rotation for a better tomorrow!

 

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer that has been a cornerstone in industrial life. Wherever there are machines or products in motion, SKF bearings are there to reduce friction. SKF drives the industries that support our way of life, powers the machines that put food on the table, and even helps explore the cosmos.

 

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. SKF is on pace to decarbonize all its production facilities by 2030.

 

We’re guided by our SKF values. Collaboration is critical to the success of our colleagues, partners, and customers. Curiosity and Courage provide a foundation for innovation and advancement. And we do this work out of Care for our people, customers, communities, and the planet.

 

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.

 

Learn about SKF at www.skf.com.

 

Key Purpose of the Job:

The PLM Team, part of Product Development Solutions under Digital Engineering and Innovation (DEI), plays a key role in establishing the SKF Vision “A world of reliable rotation”, by supporting the SKF Business Community in the management of the Technical Product Information in the full value chain. As part of the PLM team, the Development solutions team is accountable for developing and maintaining the overall PLM solutions and integration to key SKF Enterprise systems. In addition, this team is also responsible for defining technology roadmaps based on the PLM Strategy and ensure new capabilities and solutions are built accordingly.

The individual will lead PLM Implementations in different Business Areas within SKF. This involves managing the Implementation/roll-out(s) with high level of technical competence through the process of capturing requirements, implementing solutions and ensuring the Business teams are using the tool throughout the process. This also involves participation in Global initiatives aimed at implementing new technologies/modules. He/she will carry out all needed support activities within the portfolio to achieve exceptional results through – personal effectiveness, partnering with others & building customer loyalty fulfilling their needs in an efficient & effective manner

 

Qualifications:

Bachelor(s) or Master degree in (Mechanical, Electronics or Computers) Engineering stream
10-12 Years of relevant work experience in PLM (preferably Windchill)
3-5 years of proven experience in actively developing and implementing PLM solutions in the business
Highly motivated & self-initiator to achieve planned results & business objectives
Must have good communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a matrix organization setup;
Being an individual contributor, the position holder is an epitome of “Doing things correctly” & “Right from me”;
Ability to work within a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
RESP : Able to support region specific business demand/request (Americas) and solve incidents in PLM and CAD environment

 

Skills & Knowledge:

Proven experience of defining and implementing Windchill solutions with CAD (preferably Creo)
In-depth knowledge and demonstrated working experience in defining and implementing core PLM Modules (Part/BOM management, CAD management, ECM management, Document Management, Workflow Management, Classification & Options and Variant Mgmt.,)
Working Knowledge of CAD integration with Windchill (Creo/Workgroup manager)
Should be able to analyse the business process and map to the PLM standard defined in SKF
Able to spin-off quick turnaround of Proof of concepts (PoC) via agile process showcasing speed and urgency
Quickly understand the characteristics (way of working, design/review processes, methods used) in the product development/engineering teams
Should be able to plan and manage the execution of the end-end Implementation via SAF(e) methodology
Knowledge of engineering processes (ETO, CTO & ATO), Application Engineering process, Sales process is preferred
Exposure to Agile process and methodology is an added advantage
Knowledge of Thingworx/Navigate can be an added advantage

 

Key Responsibilities

Business Support

Support Local (US Business) and Global Business team(s)
Able to support both region specific and global business demand/request (Americas) and solve incidents in PLM and CAD environment
Engage and drive PLM project initiatives/strategy for local/global teams and drive to closure
Initiate & coordinate training/webinar and execute SKF specific training utilizing the in-depth knowledge of PDMLink to the user community

 

PLM Implementation

Able to configure/implement PDMLink solution(s) to suit business needs
Understanding the functionalities of SKF key PLM customizations
Ensure the solution is moved through the staging process (start with the Dev server, move to QA and to PROD) supported by thorough test plan to get acceptance of the implemented solution.
Be part of the PLM team to verify/validate applications during release/roll-out(s)

 

Stakeholder Management

Able to interact with external suppliers and SKF stakeholders during PLM implementations.
Facilitate stakeholder engagement and provide regular updates on program progress.
Be recognized and be a champion (SPOC) for Business teams

 

Change Management

Support change management initiatives, including training, communication, and support.
Act as a champion for user experience, ensuring smooth transitions and high satisfaction.

 

Key Interfaces & Interactions (Typical):

Users: Sales / Engineering / Manufacturing: Frequently
Global PLM team members: Frequently
Line Manager: Frequently
External suppliers: Regularly
External Customers: Adhoc

 

What You’ll Love About SKF:

Rest and Relaxation. Enjoy a generous PTO policy and 13 paid holidays.

 

Work/Life Integration. SKF supports work/life integration, home, family, community, personal well-being and health. Flexible work options available, depending on role.

 

Diversity in the Workplace. At SKF, we strive to embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in everything we do. By developing a culture of belonging, our people can flourish; leading to an inclusive, equitable environment that promotes leadership, engagement and innovation.

 

Best in Class Benefits. SKF cares about the wellbeing of our employees. Comprehensive healthcare options to fit your needs and opt out payment.  Added benefits include company paid life insurance, STD, LTD. Supplemental benefits include critical illness coverage, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs, and much more!

 

Bonus. SKF offers STVS (Short Term Variable Salary) or Sales Incentive based on company performance and at the discretion of management.

 

Invest in your Future. Participate in our 401K program that boasts a 10% employer contribution:  100% match up to 5% of your elected contribution (100% Vested) plus an additional 5% company contribution.

title: CNC Machinist
description:
CNC Machinist

Location: Sumter, SC

Salary Range: $ 41,600.00 to $ 54,000.00

 

About SKF:

SKF, reducing friction since 1907, re-imagining rotation for a better tomorrow!

 

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer that has been a cornerstone in industrial life. Wherever there are machines or products in motion, SKF bearings are there to reduce friction. SKF drives the industries that support our way of life, powers the machines that put food on the table, and even helps explore the cosmos.

 

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. SKF is on pace to decarbonize all its production facilities by 2030.

 

We’re guided by our SKF values. Collaboration is critical to the success of our colleagues, partners, and customers. Curiosity and Courage provide a foundation for innovation and advancement. And we do this work out of Care for our people, customers, communities, and the planet.

 

We’re a company committed to a culture of belonging, where all our people are encouraged to be themselves and grow their careers in an equitable environment.

 

Learn about SKF at www.skf.com.

Position Summary

Efficient set-up, operation and troubleshooting of CNC machining centers ensuring the proper machining techniques are followed and acceptable levels of quality and productivity are met within established parameters and within a safe and effective manner.

Key Responsibilities
Starts up and shut down a variety of machine(s) following established company procedures and safety guidelines.
Sets Up and operates numerically controlled (NC, CNC, PLC and other manual machines) lathes (horizontal & vertical) performing machining operations including  turning, boring and facing castings and forgings.
Selects and installs tooling into tool posts, turrets or indexing heads
Mounts work piece in chuck, or faceplate, manually or using hoist or cranes.
Performs machining operations on a variety of parts at times with high levels of complexity, ensuring machining operations are performed within the established parameters, minimizing scrap and rework with acceptable levels of output.
Reads and interprets a variety of engineering and quality specifications.
Applies practical and working knowledge of machines to make the necessary adjustments (turning dials, switches, and assigned offset/program controls) to override machine control and current machine performance.
Responsible for all inspections ensuring conformance to specifications using precision measuring instruments.  May also perform inspections for other operators if required.
Observes numerical displays on control panel and compares with data on process sheet to verify dimensional adjustments, feed rates and speed of machining cuts.
Performs continuous improvement (lean) activities as may be assigned or required.
Preforms other duties and assignments as scheduled and/or required.
Responsible for maintaining a clean and safe environment including identification of unsafe conditions.  Steel-toed shoes and ANSI approved safety glasses with side shields must be worn at all times.
Qualifications

Education: High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.

Experience: One (1) to three (3) years machining experience in precision manufacturing environment.

Technical Skills: Technical Degree in manufacturing technology preferred.

Other Requirements: 

Solid understanding and ability to use shop math and precision (micrometers, precision dial gauges, et.) measuring instruments. 
A thorough knowledge of CNC machine operation, tool off setting and basic machine code is strongly preferred.
Must be able to read, write, understand technical documentation, computer literate, read process drawings (blueprints), and engineering specifications

 

What You’ll Love About SKF:

Rest and Relaxation. Enjoy a generous PTO policy and 13 paid holidays.

 

Work/Life Integration. SKF supports work/life integration, home, family, community, personal well-being and health. 

 

Diversity in the Workplace.  At SKF, we strive to embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in everything we do. By developing a culture of belonging, our people can flourish; leading to an inclusive, equitable environment that promotes leadership, engagement and innovation.

 

Best in Class Benefits. SKF cares about the wellbeing of our employees. Comprehensive healthcare options to fit your needs and opt out payment.  Added benefits include company paid life insurance, STD, LTD. Supplemental benefits include critical illness coverage, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs, and much more!

 

Bonus. SKF offers STVS (Short Term Variable Salary) or Sales Incentive based on company performance and at the discretion of management.

 

Invest in your Future. Participate in our 401K program that boasts a 10% employer contribution: 100% match up to 5% of your elected contribution (100% Vested) plus an additional 5% company contribution.

title: Software Product Lead
description:
About SKF

 

SKF is the world leading supplier of products and solutions in the bearing business including technical support, maintenance services, condition monitoring and training.

The inherent skills and competence of our around 40,000 employees help us to fulfill our objective of creating more intelligent, sustainable and innovative customer solutions. SKF is a truly global company with presence in more than 130 countries, serving an extensive range of industries and customers worldwide. SKF started its operations in India in 1923.

 

SKF has hands-on experience in over 40 industries with knowledge and a vast product portfolio across the SKF technology platforms: bearings and units, seals, lubrication systems, condition monitoring equipment, and services.

 

We operate in regions – China & Northeast Asia (CNEA), Europe & Africa, India, Southeast Asia & Middle East (ISEAM), The Americas – to serve customers with speed and responsiveness.

 

SKF has been in India since more than 100 years and has a pan India footprint consisting of 6 manufacturing facilities, 12 offices, a supplier network of over 300 distributors and an employee base of more than 2600 dedicated professionals.

 

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in

 

Innovation is the key:

We make some of the world’s most innovative products and solutions to reduce friction. But we sell something bigger. Less friction means more energy saved. And it means that society can move forward to a more energy-efficient future where we can all do more with less.

 

Sustainability:

At SKF, we have a long history of working with industrial sustainability. It is an integral part of what we do every day. And we strive to create engagement throughout the business, not only by implementing sustainability on a strategic level, but also by encouraging the ideas and grass root projects initiated by our people around the world.

 

About Technology Development

 

As a team, we're responsible for global research, technology development, product development and technology strategy. Our group strategy is that 25 percent of our growth should come from new products. Filling that funnel with new and bold innovation is one of the things that we do. We bring customer value by combining our unique knowledge and technology in products and solutions with sustainability to develop ‘Intelligent & Clean’ solutions." - Annika Ölme, CTO and Senior Vice President, Technology Development

 

Digital Engineering & Innovation:

 

Digital Engineering & Innovation team is an international team based in multiple countries across the globe. We serve customers and distributors directly through services like Bearing Assist mobile application and AI enabled search on skf.com and provide immediate support for product selection and troubleshooting. Additionally, we support customers indirectly by offering solutions such as Engineering Tools, Product Lifecycle Management, Configurators, and Design Solutions. Many of these are AI-enabled, secure, and compliant with industry standards. We collaborate with various SKF teams to create a digital ecosystem, develop innovative solutions, and enhance our entire value chain to add value to our customers.

 

SKF Purpose Statement

 

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

To support and train the user community of SKF engineering software.

To collect and to indicate the necessary steps to correctly translate mechanical applications into calculation models

To plan own work

 

 

Knowledge & Competence

title: HR Operations Manager France
description:
About HR Operations
HR Operations is SKF’s global people experience engine — delivering precise, reliable, and human centered services that keep our organization moving. 
We ensure accurate pay, high quality data, efficient lifecycle services, and clear, timely support. As a globally connected team, we simplify processes, enhance experience, and help SKF create a better tomorrow for our people, our customers, and the industries we serve.

PX (HR) Operations — Precision in Service. Better Tomorrow in Motion.

HR Operations Manager France

 responsible for leading and developing the team delivering People Services to SKF sites in France.

What we expect you to have

·    High proficiency in English and French, both written and spoken.
·    Experience with HR digital tools is an advantage.
·    High level presentation capabilities and strong communication skills.
·    Experience working in an international environment will be considered an asset.
·    Willingness and ability to travel when required (<10%); in particular, during the initial period, travel to France will be required to meet the Team members and gain a thorough understanding of the processes.

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself. #weareSKF

You will enjoy working here if you
•    Have empathy, a true service mindset, and enjoy creating positive employee experiences.
•    Are curious, take initiative, and motivated by analyzing challenges and  delivering smart, practical solutions.
•    Work in an organized and structured manner and enjoy combining strategic thinking with day to day operational work.
•    Thrive in a  dynamic,  evolvoingenvironment where you can learn, collaborate, and improve ways of working.
•    Are business minded and have an interestin how People Experience contributes to SKF’s core operations.


What we offer you
•    An exciting global and regional working environment where trust, engagement, and change are  core values.
•    The opportunity to work in a diverse culture, collaborating across PX (HR) and other functions to shape future streamlined processes.
•    A globally recognized and successful company and great opportunities for professional growth and career development.
•    A modern, dynamic working environment in our new Poznan office, where engaged people work together to build the future of the People Experience organization.

•    Team-building events and CSR initiatives

description:

Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

 

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in

 

About Industrial Markets

The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate a commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs.

At SKF, we provide industry-leading engineering solutions and technologies to industrial market that consistently deliver reliability and efficiency in their day-to-day operations. We cater to a range of industrial sectors, including heavy industries, wind, metals, railways, and general machinery, and help customers achieve their key objectives, depending on their specific application needs and challenges around the machines and equipment.

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

title: Customer Engagement Trainee
description:

About SKF:

SKF has been making the world spin since 1907!

 

SKF is an industry-leading manufacturer that's dedicated to a culture of belonging, where our people flourish in an equitable environment that promotes leadership development and career growth.

 

SKF aims to have net zero greenhouse gas emissions at all our production facilities by 2030.

 

SKF products keep vehicles rolling, power the machines that put food on your table, and even reach into the cosmos as part of the Mars rover mission. Founded in Sweden in 1907, today SKF is publicly traded on the Nasdaq Stockholm with annual sales in 2020 of approximately $10 billion.

 

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and customer‑focused individual who is eager to begin a career in Customer Engagement. As a Customer Engagement Trainee, you will learn the foundational skills and processes that support our evolving customer service model. Your focus will be on developing the knowledge, capabilities, and mindset needed to eventually support customers more independently.  The ideal candidate is open to travel.  The Customer Engagement Representative role includes a required travel component, as representatives regularly visit customer sites. However, as a Customer Engagement Trainee, you will not be required to travel during the training period.

 

What You'll Do

Assist with collecting data and preparing simple reports that contribute to customer problem-solving.

Help manage customer requests including order inquiries, status checks, documentation requests, and other standard questions.
Practice first-contact resolution while knowing when to ask for support.

Offer observations and feedback during training that help improve workflows and customer experience.
Develop an understanding of value chain principles and how they apply to daily tasks.

Ambitious and Driven
Excited to contribute to a dynamic team
Motivated to grow in a customer-focused role
Demonstrates initiative and a strong work ethic
Strong desire to make a positive impact
Strong Soft Skills
Friendly, empathetic, and comfortable interacting with customers.
Strong active listening skills and the ability to communicate clearly.
Comfortable on the Phone
Ability to speak with customers in a professional and confident manner (experience handling calls is a plus, not required).
Customer-Focused Mindset
Demonstrate proactive customer care by recognizing needs before the customer expresses them.
Naturally curious about customer needs and motivated to help solve problems.
Desire to build a career focused on customer experience and relationship-building.
Collaborative & Willing to Learn
Open to feedback, coaching, and continuous learning.
Enjoys working with others and contributing to team success.
Analytical & Organized
Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office Suite.
Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to stay organized in a fast-paced environment.
Technical Learner
Interest in learning new tools, systems, products, and processes.
Comfortable working with data and documentation.

Comfortable adapting to new challenges and evolving customer needs.
Willingness to travel; travel will be required if hired into a permanent role.

The opportunity to work in an innovative and well-equipped professional environment that is part of a global company with an excellent reputation. You will join a team of highly motivated colleagues, who will work with you and look forward to seeing you develop your career with SKF.

This position is central to building robust relationships and truly setting a new standard of customer excellence at SKF.

 

What You'll Do

Drive Proactive Engagement: Serve as the primary, highly engaged contact for customers and internal sales teams, building strong, lasting relationships through everyday interactions and active participation in customer meetings and strategic discussions.

Exceptional Phone Skills: Proven ability to handle incoming customer calls with professionalism, clarity, and efficiency, providing excellent customer service.
Customer Champion: Possess a deeply customer-centric and full value chain mindset, dedicated to understanding, anticipating, and advocating for customer needs.
Collaborative & Influential: Proven ability to influence outcomes, effectively collaborate across diverse internal teams, and drive purposeful action.
Analytical & Innovative: Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Suite, with advanced data analysis capabilities to inform decisions and identify innovative solutions.
Exceptional Communicator: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex solutions clearly and present effectively to diverse audiences in various settings.
Organized & Proactive: Highly organized, with excellent time management, planning skills, and an entrepreneurial spirit that fosters self-motivation and dedication to achieving success.
Technical Learner: A keen interest and aptitude for dramatically increasing product knowledge and technical confidence to provide advanced support.
Flexible & Adaptable: Willingness and ability to travel approximately 20-30% to customer sites, other SKF locations, and internationally to SKF Puebla.

Diversity in the Workplace. At SKF, we strive to embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in everything we do. By developing a culture of belonging, our people can flourish; leading to an inclusive, equitable environment that promotes leadership, engagement and innovation.

 

Best in Class Benefits. SKF cares about the wellbeing of our employees. Comprehensive healthcare options to fit your needs and opt out payment.  Added benefits include company paid life insurance, STD, LTD. Supplemental benefits include critical illness coverage, tuition reimbursement, employee discount programs, and much more!

 

Bonus. SKF offers STVS (Short Term Variable Salary) or Sales Incentive based on company performance and at the discretion of management.

 

Invest in your Future. Participate in our 401K program that boasts a 10% employer contribution:  100% match up to 5% of your elected contribution (100% Vested) plus an additional 5% company contribution.

The Lubrication Lifetime Solutions Business Unit is responsible for the development, design and manufacturing of lubrication-related systems, tools and equipment. The Business Unit operates in a large number of countries and markets, with a customer portfolio that includes many major OE manufacturers of automotive and industrial products, as well as distribution channel partners. 

Are you ready to turn tough industrial challenges into high value global lubrication solutions? Do you thrive where product strategy, customer insight, and engineering meet? Are you passionate about building long-term customer partnerships and driving growth?


Then you could be our next 

 

Account Manager - OEM Solutions Key Accounts

 

We are looking for an Account Manager to drive the performance development and lifecycle management of our Lubrication Lifetime Solutions portfolio. The focus will be on Sales in DACH Region where you will have sales and profit responsibility for specified customers and industries. In this role, you will act as the owner of the product and solution portfolio, translating customer challenges and needs into scalable, high-value offerings. You will work at the intersection of engineering, application engineering and factories to create differentiation, growth, and customer value.

 

Key Responsibilities

Grow the development of your customer accounts across the DACH-region (Germany Austria, Switzerland), identifying new opportunities and expanding existing customer partnerships.
Negotiate prices and future contracts - pricing, payment & delivery terms, customer commitments - in line with valid guidelines, and ensure implementation of prices and associated discounts.
Continuously improve sales processes, tools, and ways of working to ensure a customer-focused approach based on the SKF Sales Excellence principles.
Ensure strong relationships with customers by e.g. regular customer visits (physical and remote), and by analyzing, negotiating and following up on call for tenders.
Monitor portfolio performance and continuously optimize solutions based on feedback and data, by representing the product and solutions portfolio internally and externally, including at customer meetings and industry events.

 

What you bring

To be ready for this role, you need to have:

A university degree in Mechanical or BusinessEngineering, or equivalent knowledge gained through relevant working experience.
Good knowledge of solution selling, with experience in sales for the industrial sector.
Prior knowledge and experience in lubrication systems and their applications would be an asset.
Ability to deliver profitable growth through long-term customer relationships, with experience in working with engineered-to-order or solution-driven portfolios.
Proficiency in IT tools, in particular SAP, Microsoft 365, and Salesforce.
Ability to translate technical complexity into clear customer value propositions, with proficient negotiations and communications skills.
Fluency in English and German, and high willingness to travel.

 

You Will Enjoy This Role if

You enjoy working on high impact applications where lubrication makes a significant difference to customer uptime, safety, and sustainability
You want a role that combines strategy and execution and have desire to improve solutions and build long-term customer value.

 

What you’ll love about SKF… 

A culture of diversity and inclusion!  
SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself #weareSKF

title: Product Owner - Design Automation
description:
About SKF

 

SKF is the world leading supplier of products and solutions in the bearing business including technical support, maintenance services, condition monitoring and training.

The inherent skills and competence of our around 40,000 employees help us to fulfill our objective of creating more intelligent, sustainable and innovative customer solutions. SKF is a truly global company with presence in more than 130 countries, serving an extensive range of industries and customers worldwide. SKF started its operations in India in 1923.

 

SKF has hands-on experience in over 40 industries with knowledge and a vast product portfolio across the SKF technology platforms: bearings and units, seals, lubrication systems, condition monitoring equipment, and services.

 

We operate in regions – China & Northeast Asia (CNEA), Europe & Africa, India, Southeast Asia & Middle East (ISEAM), The Americas – to serve customers with speed and responsiveness.

 

SKF has been in India since more than 100 years and has a pan India footprint consisting of 6 manufacturing facilities, 12 offices, a supplier network of over 300 distributors and an employee base of more than 2600 dedicated professionals.

 

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in

 

Innovation is the key:

 

We make some of the world’s most innovative products and solutions to reduce friction. But we sell something bigger. Less friction means more energy saved. And it means that society can move forward to a more energy-efficient future where we can all do more with less.

 

Sustainability:

 

At SKF, we have a long history of working with industrial sustainability. It is an integral part of what we do every day. And we strive to create engagement throughout the business, not only by implementing sustainability on a strategic level, but also by encouraging the ideas and grass root projects initiated by our people around the world.

 

About Technology Development t

 

As a team, we're responsible for global research, technology development, product development and technology strategy. Our group strategy is that 25 percent of our growth should come from new products. Filling that funnel with new and bold innovation is one of the things that we do. We bring customer value by combining our unique knowledge and technology in products and solutions with sustainability to develop ‘Intelligent & Clean’ solutions." - Annika Ölme, CTO and Senior Vice President, Technology Development

 

Digital Engineering & Innovation 

 

Digital Engineering & Innovation team is an international team based in multiple countries across the globe. We serve customers and distributors directly through services like Bearing Assist mobile application and AI enabled search on skf.com and provide immediate support for product selection and troubleshooting. Additionally, we support customers indirectly by offering solutions such as Engineering Tools, Product Lifecycle Management, Configurators, and Design Solutions. Many of these are AI-enabled, secure, and compliant with industry standards. We collaborate with various SKF teams to create a digital ecosystem, develop innovative solutions, and enhance our entire value chain to add value to our customers

 

SKF Purpose Statement

 

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 

 

 

JOB DESCRIPTION

 

  

Job Title:       Product Owner - Design Rules Service

Reports To:    DA Development Manager

Role Type:       Individual Contributor

Location:        Bangalore

 

 

Role Purpose:

In this role, you are responsible for driving product success by focusing on achieving meaningful user outcomes and aligning with strategic business goals. This role is part of a cross-functional agile team, ensuring that product development is efficient and user-centric.

The Product Owner works closely with the Product Manager, who is primarily responsible for the strategic impact and business value of the product. The collaboration between the product owner and product manager ensures seamless alignment between business strategy and execution.

 

The Product Owner for Design Rules Service is responsible for the SKF Design Rules Service platform; hosts SKF Design rules which can be consumed by other applications and DATPro which is SKF's major software tool to calculate bearing performance. The development team have UX designers, testers, Mobile Application developers and back-end developers.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Driving Product Outcomes
Ensure the product delivers value by driving changed user behavior and aligning with business objectives.

 

Collaboration with Product Manager
Work in close partnership with the PM to align on product mission, vision, and strategy, ensuring that execution supports high-level strategic goals.

 

Cross-Functional Team Leadership
Work closely with the agile team to ensure efficient processes aligned with agile best practices. Act as a leader who influences without direct authority.

 

Customer Advocacy:
Act as the proxy or voice of the customer in product discussions, ensuring that user needs, problems, and desires are represented in decision-making.

 

Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration:
Together with the PM communicate with various levels inside the organization. Conduct demonstrations and gather feedback from customers/users, stakeholders, including sales, account executives, support teams, and other relevant functions.
Engage with users, subject matter experts, and technical peers to gather insights and align on product goals. Collaborate closely with roles such as Scrum Masters, UX Designers, QA, and Developers.

 

Backlog Management:
Own and refine the product and sprint backlog, ensuring that features, tasks, and bugs are well-documented, prioritized, and aligned with strategic objectives. Maintain a tactical/operational roadmap covering 3-6 months.

 

Product Discovery Leadership:
Lead continuous, outcome driven product discovery initiatives in coordination with the PM to identify opportunities, validate concepts, and shape future product directions.

 

Solution Design and Validation:
In close collaboration with the UX designer guide the team in designing, validating, and implementing solutions that meet user and business needs.

 

Performance Tracking:
Collaborate with the PM to analyze user behavior metrics and track product outcomes. Monitor team performance in terms of efficiency and effectiveness.

 Candidate Profile:

 

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field
10-12 Years of experience of which at least 2 years in Product Owner role
Proven experience working with agile product teams (software development) on developing and deploying Automation applications
Documented leadership and communication skills
Good understanding of business operations and processes
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Fluency in English, other language skills are meriting  
Open to travel if needed for specific activities

title: Supply Chain Project Manager
description:
About SKF 

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company sustainable and competitive business excellence.

 

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms. About the organization: www.skf.com/in 

 

SKF Purpose Statement

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow. 

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 

Job Title:            Supply Chain Project Manager

Reports to:         Supply Chain Head- Operations India-Southeast Asia

Role Type:          Team Management

Job Location:     Pune

 

Our Ambition

We’re on our way in building a world-class Supply Chain organization that will be a competitive advantage for SKF across ISEAM region.

We're creating a connected, empowered Supply Chain where insights drive action, and everyone has the tools to make smarter, faster decisions.

Role Purpose

As the Supply Chain Project Manager for our ISEAM Supply Chain team, you will serve as the transformation engine of our Supply Chain organization. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that combines strategic leadership with technical depth. You will transform raw data into business-critical insights, drive projects from ideation to execution, and empower teams to drive operations with clarity, confidence, and precision.

This is not a back-office position—you’ll be at the heart of our ISEAM Supply Chain ecosystem, influencing decisions, coaching teams, and shaping the culture. You'll be a trusted voice in executive forums, a mentor to teams, and a key driver of our data-driven transformation.

Your leadership will elevate the analytical & technical capabilities of our Supply Chain —from tactical problem-solving to strategic foresight.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Insight Leadership & Strategic Influence

Lead projects that identify performance trends, uncover root causes, and support supply, demand, inventory planning decisions, logistics & warehousing efficiency improvement initiatives
Serve as a trusted business partner to cross-functional stakeholders incl. Planning, Manufacturing, logistics, & warehousing, transportation embedding insights into all levels of decision-making.
Shape and communicate our Supply Chain performance narrative—translating complex data into compelling insights for senior leadership.
Lead data-driven projects focused on automation, analytics, visibility, and reporting improvements.

2. People Leadership & Capability Building

Coach and mentor teams across the Supply Chain function to build confidence in data interpretation, dashboard usage, and performance storytelling.
Elevate the analytical maturity of Operations teams—fostering a mindset of curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.
Support the development of training, tools, and resources that embed problem solving, analytics into daily operational workflows.
Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies & build capability in teams on these methodologies to build a Continuous Learning organization.

3. Project Management

Drive seamless project execution through effective stakeholder engagement, governance, and issue resolution. Plan, coordinate, and lead project and steering committee meetings, including scheduling, agenda tracking, documentation management, meeting minutes, action tracking, and overall project status monitoring.
Co‑create strategies and initiatives in collaboration with cross‑functional teams (Planning, Manufacturing, Warehousing, Logistics, Customer Service) to transform operations & drive growth.
Ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope, providing proactive, regular, and appropriate status communication to stakeholders.
Establish and continuously enhance efficient project coordination services, expanding service demand and portfolio through close collaboration with global teams.
Drive continuous improvement by developing and maintaining operational metrics, identifying process inefficiencies, and contributing to the evolution of standards, templates, and best practices to increase efficiency, productivity, and overall impact.
Utilize project and portfolio management tools (e.g., MS Project, SharePoint, Power BI) to maintain visibility, enable data‑driven decision‑making, and support portfolio governance.
Manage, lead, and coach team member(s), supporting capability development, performance, and engagement. .

5. Transformation & Enablement

Drive supply chain optimization initiatives across planning, warehousing, transportation, and customer fulfilment.
Identify opportunities to improve Service level, Working Capital, Cost & Productivity across E2E Supply Chain operations.
Support supply chain network design and optimization projects.
Coordinate activities among Operations, Procurement, Manufacturing, Finance, Quality, Customer Service and IT teams.
Facilitate stakeholder alignment and decision-making across global and regional teams.

  

What You'll Bring:

7-12 years of experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Planning or Project Management.
Proven experience leading cross-functional supply chain projects.
Experience in manufacturing, FMCG, consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, automotive, retail, or industrial sectors preferred.
Experience managing ERP and digital transformation projects is a plus.
Strong business acumen and the ability to influence decisions through insights—not just information.
A collaborative, proactive, and growth-oriented mindset.

 

Technical & Educational Qualifications:

Degree in Business Analytics, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification is mandatory.
PMP or Prince 2 Certification will be preferred.
APICS CPIM/CSCP certification (or equivalent) is a plus.
Advanced proficiency in data tools such as Power BI, Power Query, SQL, Python, or R.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and advance AI / ML modelling will be an added advantage

If you are passionate about transformation and leading with impact, this is your opportunity to shape the future of Supply Chain!!

 

Interested candidate/s can share their resume to Supriya.Joshi@skf.com
